81b01d9524d716e6.title: Pochettino reveals his target ahead of first Man Utd game against Liverpool
81b01d9524d716e6.text: Manchester United’s new head coach Mauricio Pochettino arrived at Carrington on Wednesday to officially begin his duties. Pochettino was appointed United boss last week, replacing Michael Carrick, who was relieved of his duties after a poor run of results and performances. The Argentine tactician faces a difficult test in his first match in charge, taking […] Article written by Henry Thornton .
81b01d9524d716e6.content: Manchester United’s new head coach Mauricio Pochettino arrived at Carrington on Wednesday to officially begin his duties. Pochettino was appointed United boss last week, replacing Michael Carrick, who was relieved of his duties after a poor run of results and performances. The Argentine tactician faces a difficult test in his first match in charge, taking on arch-rivals Liverpool at Anfield. United won the corresponding fixture last season but head into Sunday’s showdown as underdogs following their difficult start to the season. Pochettino has won just one of eight trips to Anfield, drawing two and losing five, making the task of securing a positive result even more daunting. Despite the challenges, Pochettino is determined to lead Man United to a consecutive victory at Liverpool. “I know very well what this game means and how important it is,” he told man United official channel . “We are going to Anfield with the idea to win and be brave and to be Manchester United. The history talks for us. We need to go there with no fear. “ Andoni Iraola’s side have won just one league home game this season, offering some encouragement to the Mancunian giants. Pochettino faces considerable pressure to turn United’s fortunes around, and fans will be hoping to see an improved performance against their biggest rivals. Meanwhile, the 54-year-old has highlighted his priorities as United’s head coach. He acknowledges the club’s current predicament but remains confident in its potential, while outlining what he needs to do to change its fortunes. “I think it’s a mistake to focus too much on the current situation. We need to look at the potential of this club. “Of course, we have to recognise the circumstances we are in and take responsibility for them. But at the same time, we need to understand that football is a game where players need to feel free to express their talent. “We need to create the right environment and provide the platform for the players to perform. That is the most important thing, and that is our priority right now.” Several players have arrived at Man United with huge expectations but failed to live up to them, which helps explain Pochettino’s determination to create an environment conducive to success. Establishing the right environment could be key to his success, although United will also need to strengthen their squad. That process could begin in January, with the club reportedly ready to back him with two new signings . Article written by Henry Thornton .

d9d8445941d149c1.title: Summer signings join Lionel Messi at top of MLS’s top earners: Takeaways from the league’s salary release
d9d8445941d149c1.text: How much in player salaries did it take to earn a point in the 2026 MLS regular season? The latest batch of salaries lends some insight
d9d8445941d149c1.content: Lionel Messi has closer company at the top of MLS’s list of highest-paid players, thanks to another pair of former FC Barcelona attackers. The Inter Miami captain is still comfortably the league’s top earner, on a guaranteed compensation of $28.3m. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire) and Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City) have entered the list with the second and third highest wages, while Atlanta United’s Breel Embolo, another summer signing, ranks fifth on a guaranteed compensation of $10.8m. Second-year LAFC forward Son Heung-min sits fourth on $11.2m. Casimiro, who joined Messi in Miami at the end of his contract with Manchester United, is his team’s fourth top-earner with a guaranteed compensation of $3.54m. This comes after Miami announced his signing as a non-designated player to the surprise of some as the Brazilian arrived on a Bosman transfer rather than a loan-with-purchase, as Rodrigo De Paul had last summer, to keep Miami rules compliant. The MLS Players’ Association lists Casimiro on a base salary of $896,004. All of these earnings figures were revealed as part of the MLS Players’ Association’s twice-a-year data dump, with the latter installment dropping hours before the league’s postseason commenced. While these figures don’t include transfer fees and therefore don’t tell the whole picture of a team’s investment in its roster, it’s a useful bit of insight in regards to how each team is spending on player wages. Figures are players’ guaranteed compensation inclusive of base salary and all guaranteed bonuses; does not include marketing and other bonuses. Thirteen of MLS’s 30 clubs have a new highest earner after a busy post-World Cup transfer window. Two – Anders Dreyer (San Diego, $3.6m) and Mateusz Bogusz (Houston, $2.5m) – rose to the top after the departure of a higher-paid teammate. Lozano overtook the injured Riqui Puig after arriving with the LA Galaxy on loan from San Diego. Lewandowski, Griezmann, and Embolo hold similar status, while Charlotte replaced Wilfried Zaha with Allan Saint-Maximin ($7.2m) earning nearly three times as much as the Crystal Palace great. Other top-earners signed from beyond the league are Brais Méndez (Columbus, $5.2m), André Luiz (Kansas City, $3.3m), and Kai Wagner (Philadelphia, $1.6m). Two strikers who were traded within the league mid-season signed fresh terms that made them their new teams’ highest-paid players: Rafael Navarro (St. Louis, $4.95m) and Dejan Joveljic (Seattle, $3.7m). The standout failure of the new big earners is Alexis Sánchez. The 37-year-old Chile legend came to North America this summer, joining CF Montréal and making 15 league appearances for the Quebecois club but failing to register a single goal or assist. His $2.97m guaranteed compensation makes up 24.6% of the team’s wage bill. Griezmann’s arrival means that Messi no longer carries the largest share of any team’s wage bill, as Orlando has dedicated slightly more to the Frenchman (49.5%) than Miami has to the Argentinian (47.7%). Lewandowski narrowly trails by accounting for 47.3% of Chicago’s wage spending. Importantly, Messi’s contract includes add-ons; a portion of Apple TV subscriptions, merchandise sales through Adidas and Fanatics, and an optional ownership stake in Miami when he retires. Other notable new wages include former Middlesbrough attacking midfielder Morgan Whittaker (Colorado, $2.0m), former Watford and Everton midfielder Abdoulaye Doucouré (Charlotte, $1.0m), former Manchester United left-back Tyrell Malacia (Cincinnati, $1.04m), former NYCFC playmaker Santi Rodríguez (Columbus, $3.9m), South Africa striker Lyle Foster (Houston, $1.8m), former Celtic striker Kyōgo Furuhashi (LA Galaxy, $1.1m), Tunisia winger Elias Saad (Nashville, $1.7m), former Leeds winger Jack Harrison (New England, $3.65m), Côte d’Ivoire winger Bénie Traoré (NYCFC, $2.5m), former Netherlands striker Vincent Janssen (Portland, $1.75m), Tunisia winger Elias Achouri (San Diego, $2.6m), Scotland goalkeeper Angus Gunn (San Jose, $1.6m), and Southampton loanee Damion Downs (St Louis, $1.6m). While this exercise cannot confidently include every transfer fee paid, the timing of this year’s drop after the regular season’s end allows us to size up how teams spent on wages against the league table. Does spending more equal success? There’s a degree of correlation there, but it’s not strong. How valuable is it to get a point in MLS? In 2026’s wage economy, exactly $512,394.

5733476971b8bf03.content: Manchester United are gearing up for their blockbuster Premier League clash against arch-rivals Liverpool on Sunday. Lots of things have changed since the dramatic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa, with Mauricio Pochettino taking over from Michael Carrick. Multiple stars had suffered injuries before the November international break, which further broke the team’s back and eventually resulted in the former United midfielder getting the sack. However, things are beginning to clear up, with Luke Shaw and Marcus Rashford reportedly set to feature in the matchday squad for the trip to Anfield. Injury boost In further good news, Harry Maguire and Patrick Dorgu could also be in contention after the pair recovered from their issues. United’s official website has provided an update, claiming that both defenders took part in training on Thursday. “Mauricio Pochettino has taken his first training session at Carrington and there was some positive team news ahead of Sunday’s Premier League clash at Liverpool. Harry and Patrick returned to training today, as Mauricio took his first session — Manchester United (@ManUtd) November 19, 2026 Maguire, Dorgu in contention to face Liverpool “The new Manchester United head coach worked with his players and was able to call upon Harry Maguire and Patrick Chinazaekpere Dorgu. “Thankfully, last season’s matchwinner at Anfield took part in the full session. It was also encouraging to see Dorgu feature.” Maguire’s experience will be key as Pochettino embarks on a dangerous journey, while Dorgu’s versatility could also prove useful. The Argentine has a gargantuan task on his hands, as he seeks to take the club back into the European places . Currently, the Red Devils are languishing in the relegation zone. The new boss will need to improve the players’ physical conditioning, while getting them to play for the badge. 1f23f802efa5e86e.title: Antonio Conte reacts to Man Utd snubbing him for Mauricio Pochettino and responds to ‘afraid’ claims
1f23f802efa5e86e.text: Manchester United looked at Antonio Conte but hired Mauricio Pochettino as Michael Carrick’s replacement instead.
1f23f802efa5e86e.body: Antonio Conte menanggapi penolakan Manchester United terhadapnya setelah klub memecat Michael Carrick dan mengangkat Mauricio Pochettino, membayar klausul pelepasannya. Conte, yang juga masuk daftar kandidat, disebut oleh Fabrizio Romano “takut” pada gaya kerasnya. Dalam wawancara dengan Cronache di Spogliatoio, disampaikan Calciomercato, Conte menegaskan United tidak takut pada metodenya. Ia menambah, “Manchester United memiliki sejarah penting; saya menghormati Sir Alex Ferguson, dan komentar itu menyinggung.”
1f23f802efa5e86e.label: BERITA
1f23f802efa5e86e.body_en: Antonio Conte responded to Manchester United’s rejection of him after the club sacked Michael Carrick and appointed Mauricio Pochettino, paying the Argentine’s release clause. Conte, also a candidate, was reported by Fabrizio Romano as “scared” of his outspoken style. In an interview with Cronache di Spogliatoio, relayed by Calciomercato, Conte said United is not afraid of his methods. He added, “Manchester United has such an important history; I respect Sir Alex Ferguson, and those remarks are offensive.”

26e6e05f761ff08b.text: Fulham have opened talks with Calvin Bassey over a new contract amid reported Manchester United interest in the defender. The post Calvin Bassey: Fulham put wheels in motion to respond to Man United interest appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
26e6e05f761ff08b.content: Manchester United have conceded the third-most goals in the Premier League this season, and INEOS have plans to rectify that in January. After failing to strengthen at the back in the summer, they are eyeing a left-footed centre-back in the winter amid Lisandro Martínez ‘s exit rumours . INEOS have eyes on the likes of Castello Lukeba and Alessandro Bastoni , but it is well known that the co-owners love a Premier League-proven recruit. This is why Fulham centre-back Calvin Bassey has reportedly been identified as a top target . The powerful Nigerian’s skill set has been identified as a perfect fit for Mauricio Pochettino ‘s system. C. Bassey 26/27 stats Stat Premier League League Cup All competitions Apps 10 2 12 Minutes 900 118 1018 Starts 10 1 11 Goals 0 0 0 Assists 0 0 0 Yellow cards 3 0 3 Red cards 0 0 0 Fulham do not want to lose Calvin Bassey However, the team from Craven Cottage do not want to lose him at any cost, and have no plans of allowing him to leave mid-season. The 26-year-old has been made captain by manager Álvaro Arbeloa, and the former Real Madrid boss is keen to ensure his skipper stays put. Calvin Bassey has a contract until next summer, but the Cottagers have the option of extending it by a year. Now, according to The Athletic , Fulham have opened talks over a new long-term contract as they look to ward off United. New contract in the pipeline “Fulham are pushing to extend Calvin Bassey’s contract, with the centre-back the subject of interest from Manchester United. “Bassey’s existing terms are set to expire in the summer, with Fulham holding an option to extend his contract by an extra year. “Though nothing has been agreed yet, the west London club have been working to tie him down to a new deal, according to sources with knowledge of the situation, speaking on the condition of anonymity.” While the player is open to leaving, the west London side will make it as difficult as possible for the 20-time English league champions. Whether INEOS can pull off the deal in January remains to be seen. 5acbdbc154479b3d.title: Gary Neville makes his Premier League prediction for Liverpool vs Man Utd
5acbdbc154479b3d.text: Manchester United legend Gary Neville has made his prediction for the Red Devils’ Premier League clash against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. United go into the game, having picked just eight points in 10 matches this season. They will have a new manager in Mauricio Pochettino, who only formally joined on Wednesday. The Argentine has […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
5acbdbc154479b3d.content: Manchester United legend Gary Neville has made his prediction for the Red Devils’ Premier League clash against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. United go into the game, having picked just eight points in 10 matches this season. They will have a new manager in Mauricio Pochettino, who only formally joined on Wednesday. The Argentine has a difficult assignment to start his managerial career with United, and Neville has now given his prediction on how the club could fare in the North-West derby. Speaking on the Stick to Football podcast, Neville said he expects United’s defence to concede goals regardless of the managerial change and backed Liverpool to pick up a 3-1 victory. He said: “I just don’t think the defence can just. I think the defence will concede goals. I don’t care who the manager is. I think it will be a draw, but he is going to overrule me [on Jamie Carragher]. United will score. 3-1 [to Liverpool].” United face huge challenge against Liverpool The Red Devils did the league double over their arch-rivals last season. It was their first in a decade, which included an impressive 2-1 win at Anfield. Harry Maguire scored a late winner. The scenario is quite different this time around. United have a new manager at the helm before the derby. They have hardly had time to prepare for the game due to the international break. There could be at most one or two full training sessions with Pochettino before the Anfield trip. The Argentine won’t be able to sort out the defence in such a short interval after his appointment. Hence, United’s performance could be decided by how motivated the players are to turn around a woeful start to the campaign, which sees them languishing 18th in the league after 10 matches. United’s faithful will hope for an instant manager bounce with a third-straight win over Liverpool. The club’s attack appears in good form, but the defensive display could make or break the game. 2ff38f44ed249aa2.title: Double injury boost for Pochettino: Two Man Utd stars return to training, could be available vs Liverpool
2ff38f44ed249aa2.text: Manchester United have received a double fitness boost ahead of their Premier League clash with Liverpool. The Red Devils will travel to Anfield to face their arch-rivals on Sunday. Mauricio Pochettino has taken charge of his first training session at United since being named the new head coach. Man United confirmed the double fitness boost […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
2ff38f44ed249aa2.content: Manchester United have received a double fitness boost ahead of their Premier League clash with Liverpool. The Red Devils will travel to Anfield to face their arch-rivals on Sunday. Mauricio Pochettino has taken charge of his first training session at United since being named the new head coach. Man United confirmed the double fitness boost with Harry Maguire and Patrick Dorgu taking part in the training session. Maguire has started almost every game over the last few weeks but a back spasm forced former head coach Michael Carrick to substitute him at the break against Aston Villa. Dorgu had been sidelined for more than a month with a hamstring injury before making his comeback as a late substitute against Villa. The Danish international made an immediate impact, providing an assist before scoring a dramatic 4-4 equaliser in stoppage time. Dorgu subsequently joined the Denmark squad during the latest international break, but he was sent back to Manchester after being deemed not fully fit. The break appears to have come at the perfect time for both players, with the pair now looking well placed to feature in the matchday squad against Liverpool. Pochettino will undoubtedly welcome their return as he prepares to take charge of his first game as United head coach. The stakes could hardly be higher, with the Red Devils currently languishing in 18th place in the Premier League table. A victory at Anfield would not only deliver three precious points but also provide a huge psychological lift as Pochettino begins his tenure at Old Trafford. e706d69c04a6aae4.text: Drone footage of Mauricio Pochettino's first Manchester United training session leaked online ahead of Sunday's Liverpool clash. The post Major embarrassment for Man United as first Pochettino training session leaks online appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
e706d69c04a6aae4.content: Manchester United suffered an embarrassing security leak in the build-up to their blockbuster Premier League clash against Liverpool on Sunday. It will be new head coach Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge since taking over from Michael Carrick, and he took his first training session with the team on Thursday. Unfortunately, 12 minutes of that session leaked online after a drone captured footage from Carrington. The Daily Mail tried to reach United for a comment, but the club refused to speak. The footage was reportedly taken 30 minutes into the session. Embarrassing leak The video was subsequently posted on YouTube by CC Overview, who has stated that the drone was operating legally. Pochettino could be seen alongside his No. 2 Jesús Pérez, first-team coach Miguel D’Agostino, goalkeeper coach Toni Jiménez, his son and fitness coach Sebastiano Pochettino, and conditioning coach Silvia Tuya. cd4c80d0a2e77afe.content: The futures of several Manchester United stars are up in the air ahead of the January transfer window. 16a0b67f3eef6c1b.content: Manchester United are currently being linked with a host of USMNT stars, including Juventus midfielder Weston McKennie. Michael Carrick expectedly paid the price for the Red Devils’ horrendous start to the campaign. The 45-year-old was sacked last week , making way for Mauricio Pochettino, who left his role at the helm of the American national team. The Argentine enjoyed a memorable two-year spell at the USMNT, forging solid bonds with his players, so some of them are now being tipped to reunite with him at Carrington. Man Utd yet to make a concrete move for Weston McKennie (Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images) In recent days, Monaco striker Folarin Balogun emerged as a potential Man Utd target for January. Fulham left-back Antonee Robinson also reappeared on the team’s news feed. Moreover, McKennie is also being linked with a move to Old Trafford, despite signing a long-term contract tying him to Juventus until June 2030 earlier this year. However, Fabrizio Romano dampened the story, insisting United’s interest in the 28-year-old remains ‘quiet’, and that his future ‘remains under control’, as he recently expressed his desire to prolong his stint in Turin. The Italian journalist believes the Premier League giants are unlikely to invest in another midfielder, having spent £155 million on three new signings (Baleba, Santos, and Tielemans) in the summer. Why Man Utd are better off without McKennie (Photo by JC Ruiz/Getty Images) The Texan has been at Juventus since the summer of 2020, when he made the switch from Schalke. The Old Lady tried to get rid of him in January 2023 by loaning him to Leeds United, but he failed to seal a permanent move, as his performances were largely underwhelming and the Peacocks ended up suffering relegation at the end of the season. McKennie has gone a long way since his poor spell at Elland Road. He went on to establish himself as a key player under successive Juventus managers while playing almost everywhere on the pitch. McKennie’s Career Stats Appearances Goals Assists Schalke 91 5 7 Juventus 241 28 28 Leeds 20 0 1 The American is originally a central midfielder, but his incredible versatility has seen him shifted to full-back, wing-back, and any role in the attacking trident, including a false 9. But while McKennie can be a superb squad player, what United need at the moment is quality players in key roles on the pitch, or, as INEOS would put it, the ‘best in class’. ec5ed3bbaa7b43a0.text: Ander Herrera praises Mauricio Pochettino's passion and human approach, believing his leadership will create a positive culture at Manchester United. The post Ander Herrera pinpoints exactly what will make Mauricio Pochettino and his staff a hit at Old Trafford appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
ec5ed3bbaa7b43a0.content: Manchester United have had a chaotic international break. Mauricio Pochettino’s arrival Whilst a large number of senior and youth players have been representing their nations, the corridors of power at Old Trafford have been busy making changes. After a horrible start to the season, Michael Carrick paid for it with his job during the break. The United States boss Mauricio Pochettino was hired alongside numerous new staff members. Pochettino arrived in Manchester on Wednesday and took his first training session yesterday ahead of Sunday’s seismic clash with Liverpool at Anfield. Ander Herrera’s view Former Manchester United player Ander Herrera has given his thoughts on the Argentine coach. Speaking to the club’s media , Herrera gave his two cents on the manager whom he played under 52 times at Paris Saint-Germain. He claimed, “I know Mauricio very well, all his coaching staff. I have a fantastic relationship with him and with his people. I’m happy that he’s at the club, at one of the clubs that I really love, Manchester United, and I wish him all the best.” Herrera added, “he’s a fantastic human being. I would say that the right word for him is passion. The way they work every day of the week. I know him very well. Mickey D’Agostino, Toni [Jimenez], Seba [Pochettino], Jesus [Perez] and, of course, Mauricio. They are people that I remember. They are always open to talk, all open to receive you at their office to talk about football, about life. They are not only football people, do you know what I mean? They are also open to listen to you, to help you in other things of life. So they create a fantastic connection with the players because you not only see a coach in front of you, you also see a human being that is there to help you.” Herrera added that football and winning were the priorities but that winning was easier when the culture around the players was positive, and he felt United had hired the right people to perform this task. Elaborating further, he explained, “he is going to bring calm to the club and experience. Also he is, as I told you, a fantastic human being. He has a big heart to try to create an atmosphere perfect for everyone to work around him.” The Spaniard also claimed that he had reached out to the new assistant manager Jesus Perez in case they needed any advice about the club. Herrera continued to eulogise the new coaching team by stating, “I think he’s the right person because of the passion. They are so passionate. I texted Jesus, his assistant, that, if they want to know something about the club or whatever, I’m open here to help, to give my experience and, hopefully, I can go there to visit them.” Mauricio Pochettino Manager career stats Seasons Club Played Won Drawn Lost Goals for Goals against Win % 2008/09–2012/13 RCD Espanyol Barcelona 161 53 38 70 184 218 32.9% 2012/13–2013/14 Southampton FC 60 23 18 19 87 73 38.3% 2014/15–2019/20 Tottenham Hotspur 293 160 60 73 559 322 54.6% 2020/21–2021/22 Paris Saint-Germain 84 56 13 15 196 87 66.7% 2023/24 Chelsea FC 51 27 10 14 107 76 52.9% 2024/25–2026/27 United States 37 24 1 12 81 51 64.9% Source: Wikipedia and API-Football Featured image by Alex Grimm via Getty Images online polls The post Ander Herrera pinpoints exactly what will make Mauricio Pochettino and his staff a hit at Old Trafford appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .

b58d1a86f85e3bdf.content: Manchester United have suffered a potential setback in their efforts to strengthen their defensive options ahead of the January transfer window. The Red Devils are expected to prioritise signing a new centre-back as they look to address the defensive problems that have undermined their campaign. According to The Athletic , Fulham are pushing to tie Bassey down to a new deal as they see him as a key player in the squad. The 26-year-old could leave as a free agent next summer but the Cottagers have an option to extend his deal by 12 months. He is “highly rated” by head coach Alvaro Arbeloa, making it even more important for Fulham to give him an improved contract. The defender has several qualities that could benefit United, particularly his ability to carry the ball out from the back and drive his team forward. However, his distribution is not without limitations, as he is less effective when attempting penetrative passes to break opposition lines. There are also concerns about his aerial ability, with taller opponents potentially looking to exploit him in physical battles. Fulham have little intention of allowing their captain to leave, which could make negotiations particularly difficult for the Red Devils. Their determination to retain Bassey should serve as another reminder that United need to accelerate their search for defensive reinforcements rather than rely on a single target. A left-footed centre-back could be high on the list of priorities for Pochettino, with Lisandro Martinez expected to leave the club in the winter or summer. b43687092356b695.title: Mauricio Pochettino: Man United squad’s surprise first impression of new boss
b43687092356b695.text: Manchester United players reportedly expect Mauricio Pochettino to be demanding after his first training session at Old Trafford. The post Mauricio Pochettino: Man United squad’s surprise first impression of new boss appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
b43687092356b695.content: Manchester United are embarking on a fresh journey under their new manager Mauricio Pochettino , who took charge as Michael Carrick’s replacement at Old Trafford on Wednesday. With the team languishing in 18th place in the Premier League table after 10 games, having managed just one win, the Red Devils decided to part ways with the English manager last week. Pochettino, who was most recently in charge of the United States Men’s National Team, was identified as the ideal candidate to get the Premier League giants out of troubled waters. The Argentine met his new squad following his arrival at Old Trafford and even oversaw his first training session at the club ahead of the fiery game against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday, 22 November. A fresh report now sheds light on the players’ first impression of their new manager. Mauricio Pochettino Managerial Career Stats Seasons Club Played Won Drawn Lost Goals for Goals against Win % 2008/09–2012/13 RCD Espanyol Barcelona 161 53 38 70 184 218 32.9% 2012/13–2013/14 Southampton FC 60 23 18 19 87 73 38.3% 2014/15–2019/20 Tottenham Hotspur 293 160 60 73 559 322 54.6% 2020/21–2021/22 Paris Saint-Germain 84 56 13 15 196 87 66.7% 2023/24 Chelsea FC 51 27 10 14 107 76 52.9% 2024/25–2026/27 United States 37 24 1 12 81 51 64.9% Source: Wikipedia and API-Football United players’ first impression of Pochettino According to the Manchester Evening News , United players who have already interacted with Pochettino believe he will be a demanding manager. The report states: “The MEN understands that Manchester United players who Mauricio Pochettino has spoken with have been left with the impression that he will be demanding to work under.” The report, though, acknowledges that there is a general excitement about the future among the players, adding: “However, there is a general feeling of excitement for the future under the current crop of players.” Pochettino is well versed with the rigours of the Premier League, having spent time at Southampton, Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea. The Argentine has managed close to 294 games in the English top flight, registering 150 wins, 70 draws and 74 defeats. While he had a mixed spell at Stamford Bridge, the 54-year-old remains highly regarded for his work with Spurs, having transformed the north London side into one of the best in the league. United have to set standards United’s performances this season have lacked intensity at times, while they also appear to be low on morale. There remains a belief that the team is close to salvation but is faltering at the final hurdle. The football under Carrick has been impressive at times, but it has not been to the standards that the Englishman set last season. United have struggled to score as well as keep clean sheets this campaign. They have also lacked control in the middle of the park, despite investing over €150 million on Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba over the summer. Perhaps the biggest complaint has been their lack of fight on the pitch at times, which is something Pochettino must address immediately. The Argentine’s preference for high-intensity attacking football could just be the solution to the Red Devils’ woes. ff9ff23dc0ce006d.title: The male footballers best associated with each shirt number – the readers’ edition
ff9ff23dc0ce006d.text: Last week we selected 50 players who are synonymous with their squad numbers. Our readers spotted notable absentees so came up with an alternative list, which does not start at No 1 or end at No 50
ff9ff23dc0ce006d.content: Which footballers are inextricably linked to their shirt numbers? We picked out 50 players last week who have come to embody the numbers on their backs. It was not an exhaustive list – as our readers have proved. We couldn’t include some legends of the game – Pelé and Lionel Messi for a start – and we missed a few brilliant stories. Thankfully our readers have provided an alternative list. And, creative bunch that they are, they have begun with No 0 and ended with No 51 … *** 0 Hicham Zerouali An honourable mention should go to Aberdeen’s No 0. Zerouali is one of the very few to have worn the number (before rules were changed in Scotland). He was a cult hero during a poor time at the club, who died tragically young in a car crash. Lewis *** 1 Bert Trautmann The Manchester City No 1 in the 1940s, 1950s and 1960s. Your article said that Lev Yashin was an automatic choice for No 1. While mention was made of other goalkeepers, there was no nod in the direction of the great Bert Trautmann, the German prisoner of war who became a Manchester City legend. Yashin himself said “my only equal is the German boy at Manchester City”. Bert’s goalkeeping achievements were many. He only started playing as a keeper in a prisoner of war team before signing for St Helens in the Lancashire Combination League on release from prison. A year later he signed for City, where he made more than 500 appearances as well as playing the last 17 minutes of the 1956 FA Cup final with a broken neck in the days before substitutes were allowed, making important saves towards the end to ensure a City victory. He was also the first goalkeeper voted Footballer of the Year. Perhaps most remarkable of all, he saved 60% of penalties he faced. Unfortunately, he was not given any international recognition. As a German citizen he could not play for England and could only play for Germany if playing in the country. He would have been a certain starter in the Germany team that won the World Cup in 1954. He also did as much as anyone to repair British-German relations after the second world war. He went from being booed by 20,000 people on his City debut to being feted by more than 50,000 fans at his 1964 testimonial. He was awarded an honorary OBE in 2004. David Cronin *** 3 Stuart Pearce The greatest living Englishman; the best left-back to have played the game; the best player Nottingham Forest have ever had; and my hero (and Paolo Maldini’s). Will Kitchen *** 4 Billy Bremner The captain who drove Leeds forwards for well over a decade. Captain of club and country, Bremner was the human personification of Don Revie’s team of the 1960s and 1970s. He had skill, drive, aggression, camaraderie and he played close to (and over?) the line. Thirty years after his early death, he is still the player who Leeds fans hold up as representing the qualities they value in players. It is fitting that the only player to come close to him while wearing the white No 4 was another diminutive, copper-haired Scotsman, Gordon Strachan. As the wee Scotsman with the statue outside Elland Road said: “Side before self, every time.” Nick Ramage *** 5 Billy Wright Stan Cullis, the Wolves manager at the time, converted Wright from wing-half to centre-half. He was little more than 5ft 8in, which suggests he would not be a good fit in the position, but he could jump and time it right. He captained England and was the first footballer in the world to gain 100 caps. He also captained Wolves and led them to some headline victories, most notably against Honved. Most importantly of all: he represents football before 1960, when football was more open, more exciting and more rapid in the transition. Kevin R Cox *** 6 Bobby Moore He was the greatest ever No 6. If Pelé described him as the best defender he ever played against, how can the Guardian not choose him? He excelled at timing, passing and the ability to read a game. He also inspired West Ham and England with his presence. Tim Evans *** 7 Stanley Matthews There are still a few of us left who had the great pleasure to see the greatest No 7 of all time play, for Blackpool and Stoke City. His return to Stoke in the 1960s rejuvenated a team that had been stuck in the Second Division for a long time and helped put them back where they belonged, in the top flight. Matthews was the greatest No 7 of his day and, I would suggest, of all time. John Heath *** 9 Hughie Gallacher I never saw him play but my father extolled his virtues to me. In this day and age when players are well paid, maybe overpaid, there should be a remembrance of those who went before them and created this wonderful game we call football. Nick Johnson *** 10 Pelé and Lionel Messi So neither of the two greatest players to play the game, at least in my lifetime, is included. If we are talking about the beautiful game, then either Pelé (my preference) or Messi has to be the No 10. Richard Hirst *** 11 Mohamed Salah Simply one of the best Premier League players this decade. His number 11 was often seen from behind, with the three defenders he was about to bamboozle looking worried in the background. Joe *** 15 Roberto Baggio So obvious. Tom *** 16 Roy Keane Keane was the most iconic and influential No 16. In the era of omnipresent Manchester United pundits, it’s easy to focus on the contemporary theatrical Keane playing the disgruntled, unimpressed one in the studio so well. But don’t lose sight of Keane winning duels, covering every blade of grass and spraying un-Hollywood but massively effective balls forward. 7e435b27163c0e73.text: Manchester United are poised to support new manager Mauricio Pochettino with funds to bolster the squad during the winter transfer window. Monaco’s Folarin Balogun has been regularly linked since Pochettino’s […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
7e435b27163c0e73.content: Manchester United are poised to support new manager Mauricio Pochettino with funds to bolster the squad during the winter transfer window. A striker and a defender could be prioritised, and iNews claim that the club have identified a couple of options to strengthen the centre-forward department. Monaco’s Folarin Balogun has been regularly linked since Pochettino’s appointment, and the club are now considering Freiburg’s Igor Matanovic as an option too. Matanovic was mentioned as a possible target for United in the back end of the summer transfer window, but nothing materialised beyond the transfer speculation. A move for Matanovic depends on Joshua Zirkzee’s exit United’s hierarchy are prepared to back the new manager with a couple of signings, but it may still depend on a high-profile exit at the turn of the year. Zirkzee was the most likely candidate to depart on deadline day last summer. Everton made a late loan move for the Dutchman, but United were unwilling to accept. The decision was justified with barely any time to pursue a successor, but the club could be prepared to offload him if an early offer arrives in the next transfer window. Everton could return with a permanent bid, given they have no proper back-up for Thierno Barry. Napoli are likewise admirers of Zirkzee, and it has been reported that the 25-year-old is a ‘ fast-track option ‘ for them as Pochettino has given the green light for the Dutchman’s exit. If Zirkzee were to depart, United could step up their pursuit of Matanovic, who has been in fine form with eight goals and two assists in 16 appearances for Freiburg this term. The Croatian has a dominating aerial presence at 197cm and has impressed with his hold-up play too. He has won almost seven duels per Bundesliga game this campaign. Despite this, he is not a traditional number nine who plays as a target man alone. He also has modern traits with his movement and clever link-up play to create chances. Zirkzee has not quite adapted to the physicality of the Premier League, and Matanovic may be viewed as an upgrade, given his better aerial ability and positioning in the box. Matanovic has similar attributes to the currently injured Benjamin Sesko. He could be seen as an ideal competitor to the Slovenian once the latter is fit to play again next year. While the media claim that Pochettino has granted Zirkzee’s exit, the Argentine will no doubt assess the striker’s credentials in the coming weeks before deciding whether to sell him. 4a7d28c38f269f68.title: Ineos' heavy-handed approach with fans shows no sign of letting up in latest punishment meted out
4a7d28c38f269f68.text: Manchester United have issued stadium bans to four supporters who threw tennis balls during a protest against the club's ownership. The post Ineos’ heavy-handed approach with fans shows no sign of letting up in latest punishment meted out appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
4a7d28c38f269f68.content: Manchester United fans have had a lot to say so far this season. After a poor start to the season which has seen the club fall into the relegation zone, standards at the club are hitting depths they haven’t in decades. What’s more, fans are not only furious with their players’ performances but also with the state of the club’s ownership. Ineos’ poor decorum Since taking over football responsibilities at the club in 2024, Ineos have made many unpopular calls. They have scrapped reduced ticketing for children in 2024 and consecutively hiked up ticket prices in spite of a cost of living crisis. In addition, they have treated numerous fans incredibly badly amongst accusations of ticket touting. They have also forced many long-standing season ticket holders out of their seats to make room for more corporate seating in a show of disdain for the lifeblood of the football club. Latest issue As a result, United protested against the owners during the match against AS Roma in the Champions League and also versus Aston Villa just before the international break. The Athletic report, “Manchester United have issued stadium bans to four supporters who threw tennis balls onto the Old Trafford pitch in a protest against the club’s ownership during November’s Champions League tie against Roma.” In a sign of protest, fans decided to throw tennis balls onto the pitch in the 20th minute of the game, and the match had to be stopped temporarily to clear the field of play. The outlet states that they have “been informed by sources briefed on the disciplinary proceedings, speaking on the condition of anonymity, that at least one fan has received a three-year ban, with the club’s sanctioning guidelines stating that a “level four” offence of “missile throwing” is punishable with a three-year suspension.” The article claims, “United’s view is that they cannot be lenient about missiles being thrown onto the pitch, which has always been against ground regulations, and have to draw a strict line on the issue due to the risk of harm — if, for example, this were to escalate into other objects being thrown, or if a player were to slip or trip on an object.” Consequently, three people were arrested by the Greater Manchester Police in connection with the events. e5f45fda7dbdae14.content: Manchester United legend David Beckham hasn’t stopped since his playing days came to an end. The Carrington product owns both Inter Miami and Salford City. Beckham’s new project The Sun newspaper reports: “David Beckham’s production company is working on a George Best biopic.” The paper continues: “the film telling the story of the Manchester United great’s colourful life is in the early development stages, insiders say.” Beckham co-funded Studio 99, which recently produced a four-episode documentary of his own life. A source said: “David’s production company, as part of Authentic Studios, is bringing together a biopic about George’s life. He was a footballing genius who had his demons.” The source went on: “his life was a fascinating story and Studio 99 think they could do him justice.” Beckham has spoken positively about one of his role models in the past, describing him as a “football legend” and “one of the greatest players to have ever graced the game — and a great person.” Best died in 2005 of multiple organ failure. He struggled with alcoholism for most of his life, and it was the main factor behind his decline on the pitch and his departure from Manchester United at just 27 years old, when he should have been hitting the peaks of his power. 3ad9759f60fba873.title: What history tells us about the Premier League table after 10 games of a season
3ad9759f60fba873.text: Past years suggest it is tough to make big positional gains after a slow start but that someone now safe will be relegated
3ad9759f60fba873.content: The Premier League is about to enter the most intense phase of its season. After 10 rounds of fixtures across the past three months there are 10 in the next seven weeks. Yet if you hibernated for winter, most clubs would be in roughly the same position no matter when in spring you emerged. Across the past decade, Premier League teams’ positions changed by an average of 2.6 places between matchweeks 10 and 38. Only 5.5 clubs per season moved by more than three places over the final 28 games, with almost half of the teams (89 out of 200) shifting by a single spot at most. Every club other than Arsenal will be looking to improve their position but they need not trouble themselves too much. History shows they will probably finish 2026-27 close to their current standing. There have inevitably been outliers. Tottenham have tumbled by at least 10 places after matchweek 10 in the past two seasons and Newcastle (in 2021-22), Crystal Palace and Everton (both 2017-18) have risen from the relegation zone at this point to the safety of mid-table by May. But even moving one position across the remainder of the season can make an enormous difference to a team on the fringe of the Champions League qualification spots, or to those that sit 17th or 18th after 10 games. Not since 2006-07 have the bottom three clubs with 28 matches to go all been relegated. This fact feels especially relevant this season given two of the three teams in the drop zone have changed their manager since the previous round of matches. Sunderland have stood by Régis Le Bris but he is the favourite to be the next Premier League manager to leave their post. If we can reasonably assume at least one of the clubs currently 18th to 20th will be in the top flight in 2027-28, which is best placed to survive? It is going to be very tough for Crystal Palace. Opta’s underlying data model implies they are where they deserve to be in the table, whereas Manchester United and Sunderland should be much higher. The largest improvement Palace’s new manager, Thomas Frank, engineered between weeks 10 and 38 at Brentford was two places, which will not cut it this season. Palace have to take inspiration from the 2024-25 season, in which they also had seven points after 10 games yet rose to finish 12th. Mauricio Pochettino’s Chelsea were 11th going into their 11th game in 2023-24 before ending sixth. As they were also 11th in early April, they made a much shorter dash to the finish line, though. Pochettino’s teams usually improve as campaigns wear on, with Tottenham rising three places after week 10 in each of his first three seasons with the club. A similar lift in his new role would not make this season a rousing success for United but it would stave off the unthinkable idea of relegation. For someone to escape, someone else must take their place. Ignoring the possibility that the answer to “who?” may be Manchester City, the team in 17th are inevitably the ones most at risk. Of the 13 sides in the past decade who were outside the drop zone after 10 games but went down, six were fourth-bottom going into matchweek 11. Given that the points gap between first and 20th (20) was last lower at this stage in 2015-16, those figures may be more pertinent than position this season. Leeds in 2022-23 and Bournemouth three years earlier had 13 points after 10 games but were relegated, as did Blackpool in 2010-11 and Middlesbrough two seasons before them. Only nine clubs are now above that bar, with Aston Villa, Newcastle and Tottenham among those who are not. The table is unlikely to change too much before the end of the campaign but there is a distinct chance that a secure-looking side will perish.

1b064c335f3306af.content: New Manchester United head Mauricio Pochettino is being encouraged to set an early example by excluding Bryan Mbeumo. After replacing Michael Carrick, the 54-year-old inherited a vastly underachieving squad that has only registered a single win in 10 Premier League matches this season, and thus find themselves in the relegation zone. So while the Argentine was hoping to find a hungry and determined group eager to retaliate, Mbeumo may have let down his coach already. Pochettino told to omit Bryan Mbeumo for playing GTA all night (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images) On Wednesday evening, video gamers all around the world were delighted to unpack the newly released GTA VI, a game they have been eagerly anticipating. Apparently, Mbeumo joined the queue, and he let the world know about it. The Cameroonian dropped a post on his Instagram account, suggesting he spent his night playing GTA until the early hours of Thursday. Curiously, Pochettino’s first training session at Carrington happened to be on Thursday as well. Therefore, talkSPORT chief football correspondent believes the new Man Utd boss should set an example by excluding the 27-year-old from the squad altogether. “I’ve almost got no words for this, honestly,” said the journalist during his appearance on the Premier League All Access podcast for talkSPORT. “Up until the early hours, seemingly, playing a stupid video game the day before the new manager arrives. “How old is he, 15?! Why is he letting people know about it? There’s your example: if you’re Mauricio Pochettino, don’t put him in the squad.” Should Mbeumo be omitted from Man Utd squad? (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images) The last time a Man Utd manager decided to make a statement by dropping a key player, he ended up losing 0-3 at home. Obviously, that was Michael Carrick who ‘punished’ Bruno Fernandes for saying too much after the Champions League in Como, seemingly on the advice of his assistant coach, Steve Holland. Therefore, dropping a healthy and important player for a manager is like shooting himself in the foot, especially ahead of his club debut, which happens to be against a huge rival. Therefore, a dressing-down and perhaps a fine should suffice in this case, as Mbeumo is too important for Man Utd to be left out against Liverpool. The former Brentford star is originally a right winger, but also featured as a striker under Carrick in Benjamin Sesko’s absence, as the former MUFC coach never rated Joshua Zirkzee. 9fca675937e6cbb5.title: "I find that offensive": Antonio Conte speaks out after being passed over once again for Man United job
9fca675937e6cbb5.text: Antonio Conte responds to Manchester United's decision to hire Mauricio Pochettino over him, denying claims his reputation influenced the club's choice. The post “I find that offensive”: Antonio Conte speaks out after being passed over once again for Man United job appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
9fca675937e6cbb5.content: Manchester United have had a tumultuous few days as they have sacked Michael Carrick owing to their horrendous start to the season. United’s managerial decision Speculation has been ongoing all season over the managerial role at the club and numerous managers have been linked to the club. The likes of Eddie Howe and Julen Nagelsmann were frequently linked to the job as they are currently out of work and highly rated in the game. Unai Emery of Aston Villa and Fabian Hurzeler at Brighton and Hove Albion were also heavily linked to the Old Trafford hot seat owing to the wonderful job they are doing at both their clubs currently in the Premier League. Antonio Conte is another name that has been regularly linked to a move to Old Trafford. Nonetheless, despite being available now, United decided to make a move for Mauricio Pochettino and he has since been hired at the club ahead of their huge match-up with Liverpool at Anfield this Sunday. There have been rumours that United’s hierarchy feared working with Conte owing to his reputation as being an explosive character who demands much from the board and the club. Conte’s retort Italian publication Cronache di Spogliatoio has interviewed Antonio Conte on the matter and the former Juventus and Chelsea manager has denied that this was the case. He explained, “Manchester United has such a significant history that, even if some might have been wary of my methods, I don’t believe the Red Devils would have been afraid to bring in people capable of building something important—something that reconnects the club with its own history.” Conte claimed, “Manchester United hasn’t won the Premier League in 13 years—not since the Ferguson era! I hold Alex in very high regard; I’ve read his book, and when I was managing Chelsea, I even had the honour of visiting his home.” Finally, he commented, “hearing certain things said—I find that offensive to Manchester United.” Conte is currently out of work after leaving SSC Napoli earlier this year. 7e02fa84b0f4857e.text: Manchester United are monitoring Real Madrid defender Antonio Rudiger, whose contract expires next summer, but face competition from Chelsea. The post Antonio Rudiger: Man United’s pursuit of Real Madrid ace under threat from Chelsea appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
7e02fa84b0f4857e.content: Manchester United’s defensive woes have shown no signs of resolving, with the club conceding 30 times in 15 games this season. Harry Maguire and Lisandro Martinez are out of contract next summer, and their futures remain unclear. The Argentine is already linked with an exit from Old Trafford in the winter transfer window. Meanwhile, Leny Yoro and Ayden Heaven have struggled for consistency, while Matthijs de Ligt’s injury troubles seem to have no end. The situation could prompt Mauricio Pochettino , who took charge this week, to push for defensive reinforcements in 2027. Previous reports have suggested that United are planning to bolster their backline next year. A fresh update now hints that they have identified a former Premier League defender as an option for the job. United eyeing Antonio Rudiger According to Flashscore , United are among the clubs monitoring Real Madrid defender Antonio Rudiger’s situation. The report states: “Manchester United, Chelsea, Liverpool and Tottenham are among the clubs that have considered moves for the German international and retained an admiration for his qualities.” Rudiger has entered the final year of his contract and is yet to sign an extension at the Santiago Bernabeu. The LaLiga giants have traditionally preferred handing one-year deals to players on the other side of 30. However, the report notes that there has been no indication that a renewal is imminent for Rudiger. United have previously considered bringing the German back to the Premier League and remain hot on his heels. The report concludes: “United and Chelsea, however, are clubs likely to have an interest if his situation develops, particularly given the opportunity to secure an experienced defender without needing to negotiate a substantial transfer fee.” Antonio Rüdiger vs Harry Maguire: 2026/27 Stats Stat A. e0a6b87e1cdaf670.title: Premier League returns, Pochettino readies for United test and more – football live
e0a6b87e1cdaf670.text: Join our writers for the latest football news, previews and much more
e0a6b87e1cdaf670.content: Thanks international football, the FA Cup and the Manchester United brains trust, that was fun. We’ll see you again soon. Now it’s time to lock in on pure club action for the foreseeable. There are seven Premier League fixtures on Saturday, including five in the traditional 3pm slot, two more on Sunday and then Monday night football too. The Championship is also back with 11 fixtures on Saturday and a midday Lancashire derby on Sunday, completing a full slate of EFL after League One and League Two gamely held the fort for the past two weeks – manna from heaven. Two top-flight clubs come into this post-Nations League bloc with a new man in the dugout. The aforementioned United and fellow basement dwellers Crystal Palace. Thomas Frank’s Eagles go to Coventry (a team managed by Frank Lampard), which looks like both a tricky test and a presentable opportunity for the new man in charge at Palace. Mauricio Pochettino gets a nice easy one first up, away at Liverpool. Pochettino has already had a taste of the scrutiny that being in charge at Old Trafford brings, with part of his first training session captured by a drone enthusiast and shared on YouTube. Safe to say, people weren’t going to those lengths to see how Tim Ream’s ball progression drills went in USMNT camp. If we get anymore high-profile drone action or other newsworthy football items this blog will be across it, plus we’ll have updates from the various press conferences taking place today. Do follow along and you can get in touch via the email link at the top of the page.

8eb346736740de9c.title: “I was shaking”: Wales rugby hero Louis Rees-Zammit admits being “star-struck” by Man United duo
8eb346736740de9c.text: Wales hero Louis Rees-Zammit has admitted to being "star-struck" after an encounter with Man United stars Bruno Fernandes and Diogo Dalot. The post Diogo Dalot and Bruno Fernandes: Louis Rees-Zammit admits being “star-struck” by Man United duo appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
8eb346736740de9c.content: Wales hero Louis Rees-Zammit has revealed that he was left “star-struck” after meeting Manchester United stars Bruno Fernandes and Diogo Dalot. Decisive Rees-Zammit has been basking in glory after his heroic contributions for Wales in their triumph over New Zealand. Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 to end a 73-year losing streak against the All Blacks. The winger set up Wales’ opener and capped the scoring with their fifth and final try in the Nations Championship clash at the Principality Stadium on Saturday. He then got a chance to meet Fernandes and Dalot as Portugal beat Wales 3-2 in the Nations League. Fernandes got on the score sheet, with the United skipper breaking the deadlock inside 11 minutes. Rees-Zammit spoke to reporters at a press conference and admitted that talking to the duo was “really special.” He also shared details of his conversation with Fernandes . Rees-Zammit remarks Rees-Zammit said , “I went to support Wales football and, although they lost, I thought it was a really good performance from them, going 2-1 up.” “After the game, being able to meet Bruno Fernandes and Diogo Dalot was really special.” “As a Manchester United fan, I was a bit starstruck, to be honest. I was shaking a little bit when I was shaking their hands.” “I was sat down waiting and I was shaking. I stood next to my brother and said, ‘I’m just going to have to stand up and just try and calm down a little bit.’ I’m just a massive fan and to have the opportunity to meet players like that is crazy.” He added, “I actually spoke to Bruno about the New Zealand game and he said he’d seen the result online.” Bruno Fernandes 2026/27 Manchester United record Stat Premier League UEFA Champions League League Cup All competitions Competition Premier League UEFA Champions League League Cup All competitions Apps 9 4 1 14 Minutes 810 325 17 1152 Goals 4 2 0 6 Assists 2 0 0 2 “Whether I believe him or not, I don’t know, but he made it sound like he knew about it.” Fernandes and Dalot will be hoping to start this weekend in Mauricio Pochettino’s first game, as the Red Devils face Liverpool at Anfield. c5fc4ed1326427f8.title: Bukayo Saka may not return for Arsenal before Christmas, Mikel Arteta admits
c5fc4ed1326427f8.text: Mikel Arteta has admitted Bukayo Saka may not return before Christmas as the Arsenal forward continues his rehabilitation from a thigh injury
c5fc4ed1326427f8.content: Mikel Arteta has admitted Bukayo Saka may not return before Christmas as the Arsenal forward continues his rehabilitation from a thigh injury. Saka has been out since limping off against Bayern Munich at the end of last month, and it is understood he has yet to resume light training. Arteta revealed more tests during the international break confirmed the England forward did not need surgery and that he is expected to be out for another four weeks. When asked whether Saka could be fit for the game against Manchester United on 20 December, Arteta was unsure. “I cannot be that specific,” he said. “In four weeks’ time a lot of things can happen. Maybe it is three and then it is five. “At the end, there are a few elements. One is the healing of that tissue – and we cannot predict exactly when that tissue is going to be in the best condition to push it. Then there is the rehab plan that we have now, what he needs to do in the gym, what he needs to do in terms of treatment and on the field.” Arsenal will also be without Martín Zubimendi for Saturday’s trip to Newcastle after the Spain midfielder picked up a hamstring injury against England last week. Otherwise Arteta has a clean bill of health, with William Saliba poised to return after a long-term back injury, although Max Dowman remains suspended after his red card against Fleetwood. Christos Tzolis is expected to start but Arteta revealed Arsenal’s players are now banned from selecting themselves or any teammates in the Fantasy Premier League game after the Greece forward’s team was leaked before the win over Liverpool on 1 November. Tzolis had been out injured for several weeks but picked himself for the trip to Anfield, alerting their opponents. He is believed to have played his wildcard to remove all the Arsenal players from his squad. “We haven’t dealt with it [before] and I wanted to put new things in place,” said Arteta. “But obviously confidentiality is something critical because it’s about trust and about what you are trying to do. That should be kept as a huge secret and we’ll take measures to make sure it doesn’t happen.”

2f94a5b991e4f15d.text: Manchester United have received a final ruling on Patrick Dorgu's controversial equaliser in the 4-4 draw with Aston Villa. The post Man United handed final verdict on Patrick Dorgu’s controversial equaliser in dramatic Aston Villa draw appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
2f94a5b991e4f15d.content: A definitive ruling has been issued on Manchester United player Patrick Dorgu’s dramatic late equaliser in the draw with Aston Villa. Controversial Dorgu came on from the bench to salvage a point for United earlier this month against Villa, in what proved to be Michael Carrick’s final game in charge. United found themselves 2-0 down inside four minutes as Alysson and Morgan Rogers found the back of the net. But the Red Devils fought back to restore parity before the break. Bruno Fernandes converted a penalty that was won by Matheus Cunha before Youri Tielemans opened his United goalscoring account with a fine finish. The second half started in disastrous fashion for the Red Devils. Diogo Dalot conceded a penalty. John McGinn stepped up to take it and made no mistake from the spot. Leon Goretzka restored Villa’s two-goal advantage with a close-range effort. United looked dead and buried until Joshua Zirkzee scored in added time to set up a ferocious end at Old Trafford. There was a dramatic twist as Dorgu headed home to make it 4-4 and ensure the spoils were shared. Villa felt Dorgu’s header should not have stood. Several of the players argued that Senne Lammens had impeded his counterpart Zion Suzuki. But the referee allowed the goal to stand. VAR ratified the decision. Manchester United v Aston Villa 2026/27 Stat Manchester United Aston Villa Possession % 56.0% 44.0% xG 3.63 2.94 Shots 26 12 Shots on target 9 6 Shots off target 10 4 Shots blocked 7 2 Shots inside box 14 10 Shots outside box 12 2 Corners 8 1 Passes 502 410 Accurate passes 438 347 Fouls 18 9 Offsides 2 0 Yellow cards 1 1 Red cards 0 0 Saves 3 5 Unai Emery expressed his displeasure in his post-match comments, though he conceded Suzuki could perhaps have been stronger there, while Villa’s director of football operations, Damian Vidagany, insisted unequivocally that it was a foul. Premier League officials have reviewed the matter and judged that it was the correct call for the goal to stand. Final verdict The Premier League’s Key Match Incidents (KMI) panel said, “The panel felt that although Lammens turned away from the ball, the contact he made on Suzuki was not impactful and below the threshold for a foul, and the goal was correctly awarded.” Their report further stated, “Another one of the Refereeing Points of Emphasis for the 2026/27 Season is that challenges on goalkeepers will be penalised where an attacking player makes a clear action with no intent to play or challenge for the ball, which results in contact that impacts the ability of the goalkeeper to play or challenge for the ball.” “This was reflected in the panel’s justification for the decision being both correct on-field and a correct non-overturn – with it deemed that although Lammens turned away from the ball, the contact he made on Suzuki was not impactful and below the high threshold for a foul in the Premier League.” United are next in action on Sunday when they face Liverpool at Anfield. It will be Mauricio Pochettin’s first game in charge as head coach. 30552adabfbb96f8.text: Manchester United are planning to reinforce their attack in January regardless of whether they keep Joshua Zirkzee or not. The Red Devils have been enduring a miserable campaign, having only earned one win in 10 Premier League games. Their 18th place in the table prompted Michael Carrick’s sacking and the subsequent appointment of Mauricio Pochettino. […] The post Romano confirms Man Utd’s January plans as Sesko & Zirkzee status revealed appeared first on utdreport .
30552adabfbb96f8.content: Manchester United are planning to reinforce their attack in January regardless of whether they keep Joshua Zirkzee or not. The Red Devils have been enduring a miserable campaign, having only earned one win in 10 Premier League games. Their 18th place in the table prompted Michael Carrick’s sacking and the subsequent appointment of Mauricio Pochettino. However, the new head coach has inherited a plethora of squad headaches from his predecessor, but the management will reportedly intervene in January to try to rectify the situation. Romano opens up on Joshua Zirkzee, Sesko & Man Utd’s January plans (Photo by Molly Darlington/Getty Images) One of the main issues that have hampered the team since the start of the season is the lack of centre-forward options. Benjamin Sesko is considered the only natural No.9 in the squad, but he’s been impeded by a shin injury since May. The Slovenian returned to action in August, only to suffer a relapse that will keep him out at least until January . While Zirkzee is supposed to be Sesko’s main backup, Carrick snubbed the Dutchman in favour of Benjamin Sesko and Matheus Cunha, so United have been practically playing without a striker since the start of the season. Therefore, Fabrizio Romano revealed in the latest video uploaded to his YouTube channel that MUFC will be keen to bolster their attacking ranks in January. The Italian journalist expects INEOS to scan the market in search of an affordable solution. Nevertheless, the arrival of a new striker wouldn’t necessarily pave the way for an exit. Romano quashes recent rumours linking Sesko to Juventus, insisting the 23-year-old will stay at Old Trafford, as he remains determined to reclaim his role as a key player in the team once he fully recovers from injury. On the other hand, the transfer market expert provided less reassuring updates on Zirkzee, whose future remains up in the air. The 25-year-old absolutely loves the club and the supporters, but he’s desperate for additional playing time, having spent the last 16 months on the bench. Should Zirkzee leave Man Utd? (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images) If the Netherlands international decides to leave the club, his most likely destination would be Italy, where he has a queue of admirers beginning with Juventus director Ricky Massara, who tried to bring him to AC Milan and Roma in the past. However, Pochettino’s arrival allows Zirkzee to start afresh . So if the former Bologna star manages to elevate his status under the new regime, he wouldn’t have a reason to request an exit. Zirkzee’s Stats Under Man Utd Coaches Appearances Goals Assists Erik ten Hag 13 1 2 Ruud van Nistelrooy 4 0 0 Ruben Amorim 46 8 2 Darren Fletcher 2 0 0 Michael Carrick 20 0 2 In this case, Man Utd would still have to bring in a new striker, as Sesko’s availability for the second half of the season is nowhere near guaranteed. Moreover, Zirkzee is an unorthodox attacker who likes to roam around the pitch, so an out-and-out centre-forward would be required. On the other hand, if the Dutch attacker finds himself on the bench over the next 40 days, he should, by all means, push towards the exit door to try and resurrect his playing career. 6f17f41560c6db32.title: JJ Gabriel: Barcelona’s reason for letting Real Madrid have free run at Man United sensation emerges
6f17f41560c6db32.text: JJ Gabriel is reportedly close to joining Real Madrid after Barcelona decided the financial commitment was too high for the teenager. The post JJ Gabriel: why Barcelona didn’t fight Real Madrid for Man United’s teen sensation appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
6f17f41560c6db32.content: JJ Gabriel is reportedly expected to sign for Real Madrid, with the transfer process now in its final stages. Earlier this week, JJ Gabriel posted a farewell video to Manchester United, doing so roughly two months after it first emerged that he would not continue at the club. Manchester United-Real Madrid transfers Player United Real Madrid David Beckham 1992–2003 2003–2007 Cristiano Ronaldo 2003–2009, 2021–2023 2009–2018 Juan Mata 2014–2022 2006–2007 Ruud van Nistelrooy 2001–2006 2006–2010 Casemiro 2022–2026 2013, 2013–2022 (loan) Javier Hernández 2010–2015 2014–2015 (loan) Raphaël Varane 2021–2024 2011–2021 Gabriel Heinze 2004–2007 2007–2009 Michael Owen 2009–2011 2004–2005 Ángel Di María 2014–2015 2010–2014 Sergio Reguilón 2023–2024 2018–2020 Guillermo Varela 2015–2016 2014–2015 Laurie Cunningham 1983 1979–1984 Source: API-Football, Transfermarkt, Wikipedia At the start of September, reports revealed that the 16-year-old had asked INEOS to de-register him, as he no longer believed the club could provide the right path to help him reach his full potential. United’s decision-makers reportedly tried to convince him to reconsider and promised first-team appearances, but Gabriel and his camp had clearly made up their minds. There was no going back. It has now been revealed why the Spanish champions ultimately opted not to pursue Gabriel. It then emerged that the winger favoured a move to Spain. Initially, he was heavily linked with Barcelona and even travelled to Castelldefels to train , just outside the city. Barcelona’s sporting director later publicly denied suggestions that the club were trying to sign the teenage talent. Figures floated did not make sense for Barcelona Barça Universal , which cites information provided by journalist Sique Rodríguez for the revelation, reports: “[Barcelona] They ultimately decided that the financial commitment was disproportionate for a player who had yet to establish himself in senior football.” Reports this week suggested that United were owed around €350,000 (£301,000) in compensation. However, the same revelation claims Real Madrid are spending far more than that: “For what it is worth, the reported €10 million figure included the player’s salary commitments, payments involving the family and also the intermediaries’ commissions.” Real Madrid’s gamble Real Madrid have reportedly taken a big gamble on Gabriel, committing around £8 million to a teenage sensation who has yet to play senior football. It is quite an investment. For their sake, one hopes the gamble pays off. For United, it is now about moving on and hoping Carrington produces another exceptional talent. 168c0a9673c98809.title: Ashley Young sounds alarm over looming Mauricio Pochettino problem at Man United
168c0a9673c98809.text: Ashley Young has pinpointed a major obstacle that's threatening Mauricio Pochettino's Man United chances, even before his era has kicked off. The post Ashley Young sounds alarm over looming Mauricio Pochettino problem at Man United appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
168c0a9673c98809.content: Former Manchester United captain Ashley Young has suggested that Mauricio Pochettino could meet the same fate as his predecessors, thanks to the incompetence and chaos above him. New era Pochettino finally arrived in Manchester on Wednesday to officially take charge of the team. He was appointed head coach last week following Michael Carrick’s sacking. Carrick paid the ultimate price for United’s woeful start to the season, which currently has them sitting in the relegation zone. The Red Devils have managed a meagre eight points from a possible 30, winning just one game all term. Pochettino took Thursday’s training session and is expected to do likewise on Friday before Sunday’s trip to Liverpool at Anfield. The Argentine coach has spoken passionately about his desire to turn things around and put United’s recent troubles behind them. But Young believes nothing will truly change unless drastic changes happen at the executive level. Young’s concern The former England international told Standard Sport , “This season has been tough. I’ve said that Michael Carrick worked miracles last season with the squad that was there.” “Do I think things still need to change? Yeah, I think until things change from the top down to the manager, (United will continue to struggle).” “I think that things might start well, but there’s always going to be some issues there.” Young further stated in a separate interview , “I think he’s going to need a few transfer windows. To get his players in and get rid of some of the players that are there.” “I think it took him two or three years to get his team right, especially at Tottenham Hotspur, to then finally see the Tottenham that he wanted to see. And they were in the Champions League, got to the Champions League final, were finishing second and third.” Manchester United’s 2026/27 results Date Competition H/A Opponent Score Result 22/08/2026 Premier League A Hull City 0-2 L 30/08/2026 Premier League H Ipswich 5-2 W 06/09/2026 Premier League A Everton 2-2 D 13/09/2026 Premier League H Manchester City 0-1 L 20/09/2026 Premier League A Fulham 1-1 D 10/10/2026 Premier League H Tottenham 1-1 D 18/10/2026 Premier League A Leeds 1-1 D 25/10/2026 Premier League H Bournemouth 0-3 L 31/10/2026 Premier League A Chelsea 0-2 L 08/11/2026 Premier League H Aston Villa 4-4 D “So I think it’s going to take a bit of time. But I’m sure he’s thinking he’s going to be the man that can change things around.” Young explained that he was not surprised by Carrick’s dismissal. “I think it was always going to be a change with how results have been going of late. And I think Michael Carrick knew the size of the job that he was taking on. I’ve said that it was one of them things where, until things are aligned from the top to the bottom, I knew that there was going to be a different manager coming in.” “I think players have to take it upon themselves and have a hard look in the mirror at themselves. Now go out and represent the football club in the right way.” Liverpool vs. United kicks off at 4.30 pm. 1c10d16953d61e15.text: The drone operator who filmed Mauricio Pochettino's first Manchester United training session has broken his silence on the incident. The post Mauricio Pochettino training footage row takes fresh turn as drone operator breaks silence appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
1c10d16953d61e15.content: The drone operator who filmed Mauricio Pochettino’s first training session as Manchester United head coach has pulled down the video and issued an apology. Training footage row Pochettino took charge of training as United head coach for the first time on Thursday, following his arrival from the United States the day before. While working with the squad, the Argentine coach was captured by a drone conducting the players through their drills. Around 12 minutes of the training session were uploaded to YouTube, prompting speculation that Pochettino’s tactics and line-up may have been leaked as a consequence before the match against Liverpool. However, he has now performed a U-turn and apologised for his actions. CC Overview, which posted the footage, has taken it down from their YouTube channel. Apology The drone operator also said in a statement, “I would like to speak about yesterday’s incident. A total error of judgement on my part led to me filming some of the Manchester United training session at Carrington, whilst the flight was legal in terms of drone laws, I fully accept it was unethical on my part.” “My aim was to picture Mauricio Pochettino in his United training kit for the supporters to see for the first time.” “I had wrongly presumed that with it being close to the start of the session that no meaningful training sessions would have started so would have been some harmless warming up shown.” “I also wrongly assumed that the training session would have been open to various media outlets. I would like to apologise to Manchester United, Mauricio Pochettino and the players for my actions and sincerely hope those actions do not affect the outcome of any match.” “I would also like to state that Liverpool Football Club or any other football club were not involved in my decision to film at Carrington yesterday. The video has been removed from my channel.” “I have spent the past four years building up my YouTube channel and were well regarded in the fields I film and would now like to get back to building up my damaged reputation and making well-received responsible videos. Thank you.” Drone-gate apology #mufc https://t.co/AuIuYWkwLK — Nathan Salt (@NathSalt1) November 20, 2026 The video has spread widely across social media, racking up over five million views through reposts from other X accounts, and has been reuploaded numerous times on YouTube and other platforms.
