ddf6bbc4e14b6b8b.text: Former midfielder Paul Ince has hit out at "basket case" Manchester United over their summer signing of Andrey Santos from Chelsea. The post Paul Ince slams “basket case” Man United over Andrey Santos call appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
ddf6bbc4e14b6b8b.content: Former Manchester United midfielder Paul Ince has hit out at the club for the summer signing of Andrey Santos. Santos’ progress Santos has endured a mixed start to life at United, having joined the club in the summer from Chelsea. United forked out £50m to secure his signature. He arrived as part of United’s efforts to bolster their midfield department after the club finished third and secured Champions League football after a two-year absence. The Brazilian enjoyed a promising pre-season but only started four of the 10 Premier League games that Michael Carrick oversaw before he was sacked last week. Mauricio Pochettino’s arrival presents an opportunity for Santos to finally kick on and show his true potential. Jamie Redknapp reportedly criticised United for paying such a big sum for Santos, as opposed to going for a more proven player. In an interview with The Sun , Ince echoed Redknapp’s sentiments. Ince’s remarks The former United and Liverpool man told the newspaper, “Why did they spend £50m on Santos? That’s £50m wasted. They could have put that into the defence or bought a striker.” “They have [Kobbie] Mainoo, who needs to develop. He needs to be playing, not Santos. Tielemans, again, fantastic at Villa but it’s a different conversation when you come to United.” He added, “Tielemans, again, fantastic at Villa but it’s a different conversation when you come to United. The game’s changing. It’s not all pass, pass, pass now. You’ve got to win your duels. You used to hear Pep Guardiola say every time, ‘We didn’t win our duels, we didn’t win our tackles.'” “The game’s more physical, more powerful.” Ince questioned United’s ability to attract football’s biggest stars. “What you’ve got is players playing for Manchester United, not Manchester United players. That’s a big difference. Who’s a Manchester United player out there? [Declan] Rice, Jude Bellingham. 7f8f4d7ddd47f3e8.title: Man Utd teenager who inherited JJ Gabriel’s No.10 shirt immediately called up to first team by Pochettino
7f8f4d7ddd47f3e8.text: New Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino invited the young Jaume Camacho to train with the senior squad. After overseeing the USMNT’s two games against Haiti, the Argentine manager landed in Britain on Wednesday to reunite with members of his crew who had arrived a few days earlier. The 54-year-old had reached an agreement with Man […] The post Man Utd teenager who inherited JJ Gabriel’s No.10 shirt immediately called up to first team by Pochettino appeared first on utdreport .
7f8f4d7ddd47f3e8.content: New Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino invited the young Jaume Camacho to train with the senior squad. After overseeing the USMNT’s two games against Haiti, the Argentine manager landed in Britain on Wednesday to reunite with members of his crew who had arrived a few days earlier. The 54-year-old had reached an agreement with Man Utd’s hierarchy last week following Michael Carrick’s sacking. On Thursday, the 54-year-old conducted his first training session, which was astonishingly leaked online after being captured by a drone that flew above Carrington. Pochettino invites Jaume Camacho to Man Utd training (Photo by Jamie Squire/Getty Images) The leaked footage revealed some of the passing drills Pochettino is working on, in addition to a 3-2-4-1 setup in the build-up play. In addition to the first-team members, some of the club’s most promising youngsters were invited to train with the senior squad. But while the Fletcher twins and Jayden Kamason have become regulars in the first-team training, Jaume Camacho’s addition was a pleasant surprise. Carrington insider ‘Sully Talkz’ confirmed that the 17-year-old took part in Pochettino’s maiden training session. 17-year-old highly rated #MUFC talent, Jaume Camacho, trained with the first team today under Pochettino's first training session. The versatile midfielder/attacker is doing incredible for the U18s this season and he's also impressing internally. Hopefully much more to come. pic.twitter.com/goxM206m24 — Sully (@SullyTalkz) November 19, 2026 The Spaniard is a creative midfielder who could also play up front. This season, the 17-year-old was drafted into Man Utd’s U18 side, and he inherited the No.10 shirt vacated by JJ Gabriel, who was promoted to the under-21s in the summer, before shockingly going AWOL in September. The 16-year-old is now on the cusp of joining Real Madrid after reaching an agreement in principle with the Spanish giants. Can Camacho play a role with the first team? (Photo by Luke Hales/Getty Images) This season, Camacho has cemented himself as one of the most exciting players at Man Utd U18, as illustrated by his impressive stats. However, an immediate jump to the senior squad remains unlikely, as the conventional next step should be a promotion to Darren Fletcher’s U21 team. Camacho’s Stats in 26/27 Appearances Goals Assists U18 Premier League 7 7 4 UEFA Youth League 4 0 0 Premier League 2 1 0 1 Nevertheless, the emergence of an exciting young talent at Carrington is always met with a sense of excitement, especially with United needing a long-term replacement for Bruno Fernandes. The 32-year-old captain could leave at the end of the season . While Camacho could be too green to fill the void next term, perhaps the club should start grooming him by handing him occasional first-team opportunities, at least if he manages to convince Pochettino and his crew in training. The post Man Utd teenager who inherited JJ Gabriel’s No.10 shirt immediately called up to first team by Pochettino appeared first on utdreport .

e20b402c07b3fa99.text: JJ Gabriel is tipped to join Real Madrid having left Manchester United, with Jose Mourinho breaking his silence on the teenager's controversial transfer saga
e20b402c07b3fa99.body: JJ Gabriel meninggalkan Manchester United untuk bergabung dengan Real Madrid dengan biaya kompensasi latihan standar FIFA sebesar 300.000 poundsterling. Total biaya kepindahan penyerang berusia 16 tahun itu diperkirakan mencapai antara 8,3 juta hingga 12,5 juta poundsterling termasuk gaji dan agen. Manchester United menuding tidak ada kontak sebelum pengumuman kepergian dan mempertimbangkan langkah hukum atas dugaan pendekatan ilegal. Gabriel akan bergabung dengan tim U-18 Real Madrid dan berlatih mandiri karena Castilla serta Madrid C belum bisa mendaftarkan pemain baru. Jose Mourinho menolak memberikan komentar terkait saga transfer kontroversial tersebut dalam konferensi pers.
e20b402c07b3fa99.label: RUMOR
e20b402c07b3fa99.body_en: JJ Gabriel is leaving Manchester United to join Real Madrid for a standard FIFA training compensation fee of 300,000 pounds. The total cost for the 16-year-old forward is expected to reach between 8.3 million and 12.5 million pounds including wages and agent fees. Manchester United claim no contact was made before his departure announcement and consider legal action over an alleged illegal approach. Gabriel will join Real Madrid's under-18 team and train alone because Castilla and Madrid C currently cannot register new players. Jose Mourinho refused to comment on the controversial transfer saga during his press conference.

ef76a36402614a41.title: Pochettino quashes Fernandes rumour, fires warning to Man Utd directors: “I want to be involved”
ef76a36402614a41.text: Ahead of his Manchester United debut, Mauricio Pochettino held his first pre-match press conference on Friday afternoon. The Premier League giants sacked Michael Carrick during the international break after a horrific start to the season that left the club lying 18th in the league table. Pochettino was appointed as the 45-year-old replacement, and he’s about […] The post Pochettino quashes Fernandes rumour, fires warning to Man Utd directors: “I want to be involved” appeared first on utdreport .
ef76a36402614a41.content: Ahead of his Manchester United debut, Mauricio Pochettino held his first pre-match press conference on Friday afternoon. The Premier League giants sacked Michael Carrick during the international break after a horrific start to the season that left the club lying 18th in the league table. Pochettino was appointed as the 45-year-old replacement, and he’s about to receive a baptism of fire, as United travel to Anfield for a Premier League clash against Liverpool on Sunday. Mauricio Pochettino confirms Bruno Fernandes will remain Man Utd’s captain (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images) It has been a hectic couple of weeks for Pochettino, who left his post at the USMNT after reaching an agreement with Man Utd. But even though the Red Devils triggered a £7.4 million release clause, the Argentine refused to abandon his now-former employers in the middle of the international break, so he oversaw Tuesday night’s game against Haiti in Cincinnati before flying overnight to Manchester and immediately starting preparation for the upcoming fixture. Therefore, the former Spurs and Chelsea manager jokingly suggested that getting some sleep is his priority at the moment. “My first target is to sleep! But I cannot sleep, only three or four hours a day,” said the new MUFC manager (via Manchester Evening News ). “The target is to get to know the people, the staff, the players, and try to have an impact from the beginning, a positive one.” On a more serious note, Pochettino quashed all the rumours that claimed he could strip Bruno Fernandes of the captaincy, insisting that the Portuguese remains the skipper and a key player, although his future remains uncertain. “I think the commitment of all the players is amazing from day one. Bruno is our captain and he’s a very important player, but all the player must feel they are important. “We chatted yesterday and spent three hours chatting in my office with all the players. I missed some injured players, but in the next few days, I will talk to everyone. “Bruno’s contract? We will have time to talk about the thing you asked me.” Pochettino warns Man United about his role in the team (Photo by Jeff Dean/Getty Images) Unlike Ruben Amorim, Pochettino hasn’t taken any issue with being referred to as ‘head coach’ instead of ‘manager’. However, the former PSG boss insisted that, regardless of his position, he needs to be involved in the major decisions related to the squad. “The title of the job is indifferent. It depends on the communication and the relationship with all the areas. “I am going to decide the squad for Sunday and pick the starting XI and make the changes. In the future, I would like to be involved with all the main decisions that happen with the squad.” The post Pochettino quashes Fernandes rumour, fires warning to Man Utd directors: “I want to be involved” appeared first on utdreport .
ef76a36402614a41.body: Mauricio Pochettino mengadakan konferensi pers pra‑pertandingan pertama menjelang debutnya melawan Liverpool di Anfield pada Minggu. Ia menegaskan Bruno Fernandes tetap menjadi kapten United, menepis rumor akan dicopot. Pochettino mengeluh kurang tidur, “Target pertama saya tidur! Tapi saya hanya dapat tiga atau empat jam per hari,” serta menegaskan keinginannya terlibat dalam semua keputusan skuad. United baru saja memecat Michael Carrick setelah musim buruk, memicu pemecatan dengan klausul pelepasan £7,4 juta.
ef76a36402614a41.label: BERITA
ef76a36402614a41.body_en: Mauricio Pochettino held his first pre‑match press conference ahead of his United debut against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. He confirmed Bruno Fernandes will stay as captain, dismissing any talk of stripping him. The new boss complained about lack of sleep – “My first target is to sleep! But I can only get three or four hours a day” – and said he wants to be involved in all major squad decisions. United had just sacked Michael Carrick after a disastrous start, triggering a £7.4 million release clause.

d49a9adeb24bcf90.content: Manchester United’s hopes of landing Como midfielder Nico Paz have been dented significantly as Real Madrid step in. Paz interest Given his outstanding form at both club and international level, Paz is much sought after and is establishing himself as one of Europe’s premier attacking midfielders. United got a demonstration of what he can do in October, when he put two goals past them, helping Como to a dominant 4-1 triumph at the Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium. Paz has managed three goals and as many assists in 10 Serie A appearances so far this term. Across all competitions, he has notched six goals and eight appearances across all competitions. His ascent within the Argentina national team setup has resulted in him being billed as the successor to Lionel Messi. Now, Deportes COPE has issued a major update on Paz. Paz latest Real Madrid retain the option of buying back Paz from Como and, according to Deportes COPE on COPE radio, they have decided to exercise it. Los Blancos considered signing Paz last summer, only for the player to choose Como and his own development instead; it looks to have been a masterstroke. This time, Madrid’s stance is unequivocal. 21dfdc55cff76afd.content: Manchester United may have a decision to make over Mason Mount come January, given what is emerging from Italy. More than three years after joining from Chelsea in a £60 million deal, Mount has never justified that investment from the Red Devils. Mason Mount 2026-27 Stat Mason Mount · UEFA Champions League Mason Mount · Premier League M. In fact, he has shown glimpses of brilliance now and then. He is the type of player who, when watched, reveals a coach’s tactical plan because he executes it perfectly. That is why almost every gaffer seems to like him. However, injury problems have denied him consistency. Mysterious knocks picked up in training, often after strong displays, have stopped the former Chelsea star building momentum and nailing down a regular starting spot. As Mauricio Pochettino ’s era kicks off, Mount appears to have the next few weeks to prove himself. Otherwise, come January, INEOS could contemplate cashing in on him, with an exit route opening up. Napoli eye Mount According to TuttoMercatoWeb , Napoli, in their quest to strengthen their squad, will not just target United’s Joshua Zirkzee. They are also set to try and sign Mason Mount . The Partenopei will be ready to strike a deal in January if INEOS “are open to a favourable transfer.” It is still too soon to judge whether United would look to cash in on Mount. Last chance saloon That said, over the next month Pochettino will get a proper look at the players at his disposal. Mount, like every other player, will get the chance to shape his fate at M16. If he clicks in the Argentine’s tactical plan, then he could save his United career. But if he fails to prove his worth, he may be one of the casualties as INEOS looks to overhaul this United squad into one that can steer them back to glory. 8946f37038079d7b.title: Premier League news: Grealish available again for Everton, Maresca hints at City tweaks
8946f37038079d7b.text: The Everton forward returns from disciplinary suspension, while Enzo Maresca acknowledges City’s midfield needs balance
8946f37038079d7b.content: Grealish returns after four games missed David Moyes has confirmed Jack Grealish is fit and available for Everton’s visit to Brentford on Monday after his recent disciplinary breach. Grealish missed Everton’s past four games mainly as a consequence of missing training before last month’s Carabao Cup win over Newcastle. His last appearance for the team was in the 2-0 loss to Chelsea on 17 October, but Moyes is now prepared to welcome the playmaker back into the fold. “He’s back in training and back in around the team,” the Everton manager said. The 31-year-old played in a behind-closed-doors fixture against Derby last week and apologised on social media for being unable to help the team, who have performed well in his absence. Moyes said of the apology: “I don’t do social media but I’ve heard about it.” Asked whether he had received a similar apology from Grealish in person, the Everton manager added: “We’ve just been getting on with our work. We’ve got a lot of other players here who we need to focus on as well, I can’t just concentrate on one player, and I’ve been trying to make sure everybody gets the right preparation for our next game against Brentford.” The Scot backed Jordan Pickford to respond strongly to the threat from James Trafford to his England place after the Leeds goalkeeper’s inclusion and impressive display in the Nations League win over Spain. “I don’t think it will have a great effect on him,” claimed Moyes. “If you’re playing for England you will always have other players chasing you. I still think Jordan Pickford is out there on his own at the moment. If anything, he’s getting better. It will be good for us now that he’s getting competition [with England].” Andy Hunter Maresca backs Fernández but hints at tweaks Enzo Maresca has said he may need to tweak the balance of Manchester City’s midfield amid their faltering Premier League form. City went into the November international break on the back of three consecutive defeats in the league, having begun the campaign with seven wins on the bounce. Maresca’s side are third in the table, six points off leaders Arsenal, and face Fulham at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday. Maresca defended Enzo Fernández, whose performances have prompted debate over his best position and whether he leaves City’s team unbalanced. Maresca has mostly opted to play the £125m signing from Chelsea deeper in midfield alongside fellow summer recruit Elliot Anderson, with the more defensive-minded Ayyoub Bouaddi, who also arrived in the summer, largely a substitute. “For sure there are things we need to do better in terms of balance,” Maresca said. “But the same midfield that won seven games in a row is the same midfield that lost three games in a row. “We won games with Enzo, we lost games with Enzo. I know that when there is a defeat, we are all looking for the reason why. Sometimes we probably need more balance, we need different kinds of players. [It] depends a little bit on the game. The idea is to continue in attack in the same way, creating chances, but finding a balance when we defend.” Maresca also dismissed the notion that any uncertainty surrounding City’s financial case with the Premier League has negatively affected recent performances. It has been nearly two months since City were found guilty of more than 100 charges related to breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules, and they are waiting for the outcome of their appeal. All three of City’s league defeats have come since the ruling. “I don’t think the players are thinking too much about the noise,” Maresca said. “I don’t think they are worried about it.” Dominic Booth Iraola: drone filming ‘shouldn’t be legal’ Andoni Iraola believes Manchester United have an advantage on Sunday with Mauricio Pochettino set to take charge of his first game but criticised unauthorised drone footage of the Argentinian’s first training session. Pochettino faces a daunting maiden outing when United travel to face Liverpool at Anfield. A drone operator apologised after posting a 12-minute video from Carrington on YouTube – since removed – which Liverpool head coach Iraola said he has seen. “Yesterday they were sending me the footage but I think the important part of this is it shouldn’t be legal,” said the Spaniard. “It happened to United but it could happen today to me. Yesterday you had access to our training, the cameras recorded also 15, 20 minutes of our training, you know who trained with us, you know who didn’t train. We know the same but it’s not a matter of the advantage, I think it’s the fact someone can do this. I think there is a reason we train behind closed doors because there are some things you have to respect and I don’t think it’s nice for any club.” With Pochettino having left his role as US boss to take charge at Old Trafford, there will be a considerable element of the unknown for Liverpool. He added of former Tottenham and Chelsea boss Pochettino: “We’ve faced each other and obviously he has a lot of Premier League games behind him that we can look at, we can look at games from the US. But it’s true they have this small advantage that we don’t have references to prepare because they can go different ways that we don’t know right now.” Liverpool have been boosted by the news Virgil van Dijk, Ryan Gravenberch and Jeremie Frimpong are all set to be available, while the international break has seen long-term absentees Conor Bradley and Giovanni Leoni take a step forward. e5f977ad3f0aeb70.title: The Premier League resumes: here’s our almost essential club-by-club recap
e5f977ad3f0aeb70.text: In today’s Football Daily: A rundown on the state of play as we prepare to feel something
e5f977ad3f0aeb70.content: WHERE WERE WE? Just like taking the Manchester United job or listening in on a conversation with Stephen Warnock, the men’s international break can be a long, hard slog, a domestic hiatus so long that we can forget both basic hygiene and how the clubs are faring in the Best League in the World™: the Championship the Premier League. So after desperately trying to break into either tears or just a smile at Harry Kane’s appearance record – no dice, unfortunately – here is a rundown on the state of play for each club, as we prepare for a weekend of football that might actually make us feel something. 1 Arsenal There are some genuinely likable things about the Gunners – Bukayo Saka, Paul Merson being a bit giddy, Ben White’s apathy to it all – but Arsenal fans were a lot easier to manage when they weren’t this good. It’s theirs to lose, etc. 2 Brighton Turns out all you need to turn your club into genuine title contenders is a world-class recruitment programme and Pascal Gross to accidentally realise that he’s the second coming aged 35. 3 Manchester City Enjoy it while it lasts, lads. 4 Liverpool These lot haven’t been title contenders since Mohamed Salah started playing like Robert Snodgrass and haven’t looked like vastly improving since replacing the right-winger with various different, expensive left-wingers. 5 Chelsea Anything could and probably will happen with the Blues, and that’s not a compliment. 6 Everton The Toffees should be worse than last season – Iliman Ndiaye has left, Jack Grealish issued a grovelling apology after going awol, their only striker is Thierno Barry – but instead they are much, much better. David Moyes, the genius grandpa of the league at 63, will set a new Everton record for games managed this weekend (593). 7 Bournemouth The Dorset Hydra from Greek mythology. Every time you cut off its head, or sell a defender to PSG or Real Madrid, they come back stronger. Since Alex Scott was injured on 3 October, Bournemouth lost at Chelsea and then won eight on the bounce. Make it make sense. 8 Brentford This underdog narrative is wearing a little thin now. Brentford are just a well-oiled football machine but they have no mates and worse, no enemies. What a sad little life. Enjoy Tin Pot qualification. We hope it makes you very happy. 9 Leeds The Yorkshire club might be 78% Dominic Calvert-Lewin at this point, so only Lucas Radebe knows where they will be when the striker gets knacked, but Daniel Farke is doing a fine job with Leeds in the top half. For now. 10 Aston Villa It would be hard for any club to lose Morgan Rogers, Ezri Konsa, Ollie Watkins, Youri Tieleman and Emi Martínez in one transfer window and improve. Not much more to say. Why do we like Zion Suzuki so much? Genuinely not sure. 11 Tottenham Whisper it, but are Spurs back (to being a mid-table team again)? 12 Newcastle One win in six and a kit that looks like a barcode means it’s been a poor campaign thus far, which Matthias Jaissle and co will hope to resurrect this weekend against – checks notes – the champions. Ah. 13 Hull City A remarkable achievement that the promoted side are not anywhere near the bottom three considering there is absolutely nobody, including Sergej Jakirovic, who can name 11 current Hull players off the top of their heads. 14 Ipswich Town Shining bright like Gary O’Neil’s teeth. Keep this up and they might even survive. 15 Fulham Quick tip for Álvaro Arbeloa: when you said on Friday that “Fulham is not a jail – everyone that is here is because they want to be here”, it really makes it sound like Fulham is actually a jail, which nobody wants to be in. Roll on Manchester City (A)! 16 Nottingham Forest It’s entirely believable that Forest will follow up their 3-1 win over Manchester City with victory at Bournemouth this weekend. It’s also entirely believable that Oliver Glasner will be sacked by Christmas and Forest will be playing in the Championship next season. It’s all part of the Evangelos Marinakis Experience, baby. 17 Coventry City Genuinely quite nice to see that sky blue kit back in the top flight. All Cov fans would snap your hand off for 17th come the end of the campaign. 18 Manchester United Mauricio Pochettino has the chance to do something very, very funny over the next few months. 19 Sunderland Turns out qualifying for Europe isn’t all it’s made up to be. 20 Crystal Palace The Eagles are surely too good to go down? Their trip to Coventry this weekend absolutely stinks of a six-pointer. Hard not to believe that Thomas Frank’s lovely locks will sort out the mess in south London. Imagine if Adam Wharton had Thomas Frank’s hair? OK, that’s enough Football Daily for today. QUOTE OF THE DAY “My aim was to picture Mauricio Pochettino in his ‌United training kit for the supporters to see for the first time. I fully accept it was unethical on my part. I would like to apologise to Manchester United, Mauricio Pochettino and the players for my actions and sincerely ‌hope those actions do not affect the outcome of any match” – a drone operator who filmed United’s first ⁠training ⁠session under their new head coach at Carrington has apologised for what he called a “total error of judgment”. Welcome to Manchester, Mauricio. FOOTBALL DAILY LETTERS I’m a bit late to the party in terms of commenting on the ‘perfume in Poundland’ litigation (Football Daily letters passim). However, I can’t help thinking that David Beckham could have avoided all of this palaver if he’d arranged for Dior to manage his line of fragrances – it seems to have worked out swimmingly for Robbie Sauvage” – Paul Taverner. 71ec373809210810.title: Pochettino could exploit Liverpool's recurring weakness to make winning Man Utd start
71ec373809210810.text: Manchester United are back in Premier League action on Sunday, facing rivals Liverpool at Anfield in Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge. Pochettino will be aiming to secure a victory at a ground where he has struggled in the past. He has won one, drawn two and lost five of his previous eight visits to […] Article written by Henry Thornton .
71ec373809210810.content: Manchester United are back in Premier League action on Sunday, facing rivals Liverpool at Anfield in Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge . Pochettino will be aiming to secure a victory at a ground where he has struggled in the past. He has won one, drawn two and lost five of his previous eight visits to Anfield. Man United’s coaches since Sir Alex Ferguson’s departure have generally enjoyed positive starts to their reigns. Of the previous 12, eight won their first match in charge, two drew and two suffered defeats. Pochettino could also win his first match if he can exploit Liverpool’s recurring weakness this season. The Reds have struggled to break down their opponents, registering the third fewest big chances in the division . Liverpool’s defeat to Arsenal highlighted that problem, as they failed to register a shot on target and created just one big chance despite having 17 attempts. The Reds’ difficulty in breaking down organised defences was also evident in their victory over Crystal Palace. The hosts are particularly dangerous when they have space to exploit, with the pace of their attackers posing a significant threat. Bradley Barcola, for example, ranks second in the Premier League for top speed this season. Pochettino cannot afford to take an expansive approach against Liverpool, particularly given Man United’s own defensive struggles. The Red Devils are better served in adopting a solid defensive shape to nullify the hosts’ attacking threat and hit them on the counter. Former head coach Ruben Amorim adopted a similar approach in the corresponding fixture last season. United had just 36 percent possession but still secured a 2-1 victory. A win against Liverpool would hand Pochettino a dream start, while a draw would also be considered a respectable result given the circumstances and United’s recent form. 4f56701d05c14ee3.title: World-class manager who wanted Man Utd job slams INEOS for snubbing him: “Frightened of winning”
4f56701d05c14ee3.text: After missing out on the Old Trafford hot seat, Antonio Conte aimed a not-so-subtle dig at the Manchester United hierarchy. The faltering Premier League giants decided to sack Michael Carrick after a catastrophic start to the season that left the team in the relegation zone. While several candidates were proposed for the role, Mauricio Pochettino […] The post World-class manager who wanted Man Utd job slams INEOS for snubbing him: “Frightened of winning” appeared first on utdreport .
4f56701d05c14ee3.content: After missing out on the Old Trafford hot seat, Antonio Conte aimed a not-so-subtle dig at the Manchester United hierarchy. The faltering Premier League giants decided to sack Michael Carrick after a catastrophic start to the season that left the team in the relegation zone. While several candidates were proposed for the role, Mauricio Pochettino was eventually identified as the most-suited profile for the role. Antonio Conte accuses Man Utd of being afraid of winning (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) Interestingly, United had the opportunity to pick an unattached manager, with the likes of Conte, Julian Nagelsmann, and Eddie Howe all being free agents . Last month, Conte sent a public message to the Man Utd management , declaring his desire to revive a struggling European giant. Most observers agreed the Italian head coach either meant MUFC or his former employers, Juventus. However, the Red Devils chose to pursue Pochettino, despite being tied to the USMNT until the 2030 World Cup. “WE ARE ANIMALS OF THE GRASS!” Mauricio Pochettino on his return to club football with Man Utd pic.twitter.com/t2wYqdkQIM — BeanymanSports (@BeanymanSports) November 20, 2026 INEOS took advantage of release clause inserted in the Argentine’s contract, paying £7.4 million just to free him from his obligations. Media reports (specifically from The Athletic) claimed Conte was overlooked because his methods didn’t convince the club directors, who considered him ill-suited for the role. Therefore, the former Chelsea, Spurs, and Napoli manager has responded to these reports by emphasising his winning mentality, arguing that anyone who snubs him is afraid of success. “If anyone is frightened by my method, then they are frightened of winning, because that methodology leads to victory. That is my answer,” said the 56-year-old in his interview with Cronache di spogliatoio (via Sport Witness ). “Manchester United has such a significant history that I find it strange to imagine anyone could be afraid of an approach aimed at restoring the club to its true stature. They last won the league in 2013, under Ferguson. I have immense respect for Sir Alex Ferguson.” Conte also recalled a meeting with Ferugon, while accusing those in charge of the club of sabotaging any serious attempt at revival, at least if those reports about him were true. “I’ve read his book, and when I was in London, I was fortunate enough to visit his home and spend a day with him. He has an incredible passion for talking about football, though, at times, his Scottish accent can be quite hard to follow! Through his own methodology and approach, he made Manchester United great. “That is why I find certain remarks almost offensive toward United; it’s as if someone were placing a veto on the club’s return to its own history. A method is what’s needed to achieve major results. And if you’re suggesting that this method requires hard work, well, yes, it does. Everyone has to work hard, not just the players.” Is Conte right to bash the Man Utd management? (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) Needless to say, the Italian’s blunt words have echoed what many MUFC supporters and observers have been saying for years. Over the past 15 years, Conte has established himself as one of the most accomplished managers in Europe, and his track record illustrates a tactician who has constantly delivered positive results. Conte’s Stats per Season Club League Final Standing 06/07 Arezzo Serie B 20 07/08 Bari Serie B 11 08/09 Bari Serie B 1 10/11 Siena Serie B 2 11/12 Juventus Serie A 1 12/13 Juventus Serie A 1 13/14 Juventus Serie A 1 16/17 Chelsea Premier League 1 17/18 Chelsea Premier League 5 19/20 Inter Milan Serie A 2 20/21 Inter Milan Serie A 1 21/22 Tottenham Premier League 4 22/23 Tottenham Premier League 5 24/25 Napoli Serie A 1 25/26 Napoli Serie A 2 Therefore, the Lecce native isn’t accustomed to getting snubbed for a job, so this could be a tough pill for his pride to swallow, especially after (implicitly) offering his services in public. It can be argued that his eyebrow-raising statement about INEOS is partially prompted by a sense of bitterness. But while many in the fanbase would rue missing out on the serial winner, the supporters must rally around Pochettino. The Argentine’s resume might not be as impressive as Conte’s, but it does contain magical moments and unexpected achievements that Man Utd fans would love to experience. 25b5938fe51445e6.title: Training hard and biding his time, Dele Alli has not given up on football yet
25b5938fe51445e6.text: The 30-year-old former England star combines Twitch streaming with working to return to the top as a player
25b5938fe51445e6.content: Consider the training regime Dele Alli has followed since he left Como 18 months ago and it becomes clear why he takes exception to suggestions he has given up on football in favour of becoming an internet personality. He trains five or six days a week with Connor Peters, an elite performance coach who has worked with players including Trevoh Chalobah. They spend four days on the pitch and days in between in the gym. A typical day begins at 9am with an hour of activation and stretching before Dele heads to non-league Windsor & Eton at 11am, where he trains on the pitches and uses the facilities. Then it’s back home to use his own oxygen chamber and sauna for a recovery session. “We’ll do maybe two days on, one day off, and then three days on, one day off,” says Peters. “We’ve been doing that for just over a year now. It’s full-on. It’s pretty much as if you were at a club.” Dele rose as a teenager to a level of stardom few experience and, used to media attention, doesn’t mind that his absence from football draws scrutiny. But he disagrees with the suggestion that choosing to stream on Twitch is a sign he has lost interest in the game that made him wealthy enough to never need to work again. To a modest Twitch audience, he sometimes plays video games, sometimes just talks. He has a knack for creating viral content, sharing a phone call with Harry Kane and playing a game of EA Sports FC with IShowSpeed, one of the most famous online influencers. When he lost that game – and a bet – he wore an Arsenal shirt, apologising to Spurs fans before burning it. When TalkSport pundits claimed Dele was wasting his potential by becoming a streamer, Dele responded in a live stream, pointing out he was recording himself in his spare time and if he was out at nightclubs, it would be worse. Even then he was polite. “When people see him online streaming or whatever he does in his private time, the initial thought is: ‘He’s done with football, then,’” Peters says. “He’s been training for a year and a half by himself. If he was done with football he wouldn’t be doing that. His actions show that the hunger is still there. A lot of people would come out of the game and then stop and lose the hunger for it, but he’s still chipping away every day, trying to get back and get to somewhere that he’s happy with.” Dele broke through at MK Dons as a slight but devilish defensive midfielder, dominating League One midfields full of hardened professionals, before being scouted by Tottenham. Mauricio Pochettino attended MK Dons’ 4-0 League Cup win against Manchester United in 2014 and saw enough to leave early and convince Daniel Levy to pay £5m. By the time Dele turned 21, his statistics were superior to Cristiano Ronaldo’s at the same age: 26 goals and 14 assists to Ronaldo’s 14 and 13. His 40 goal involvements equalled Frank Lampard, Steven Gerrard and David Beckham combined at the same age. “He’s scored more in his first 50 league games than Steven Gerrard, Wayne Rooney and Frank Lampard,” Pochettino wrote in his book Brave New World. “He may go on to be better than all of them because he has the quality; now he just needs consistency.” But there were, perhaps, warning signs of what would happen at Spurs. One source who worked closely with Dele describes him as a “cheeky chappy”; charming and universally popular. He wasn’t one to miss training, but there were concerns he wasn’t leading the pristine lifestyle of many elite players, and tabloid stories about his private life trailed him. Pochettino was concerned when he saw Dele’s WhatsApp photo, a cartoon of a boy surrounded by people wanting a piece of him, believing he needed support from the right people. John McDermott, the head of coaching and development, said: “When the trough is full, the pigs come from all over to feed.” When Dele voluntarily liquidated one of his companies this month, documents showed an estimated surplus after costs of £7.6m, suggesting the 30-year-old has not squandered the millions he earned at his peak in wages and sponsorship agreements, including a five-year deal with Adidas. He also owns a property portfolio worth more than £1.5m. In the early days Pochettino warned Dele about the danger of not giving maximum effort in matches and training, a sentiment later shared by José Mourinho when he became Spurs manager. “I think one day you will regret, if you don’t reach what you can reach,” Mourinho told Dele in his office as Amazon Prime’s cameras rolled. Although Dele formed a formidable relationship with Kane on the pitch, and was twice named the Professional Footballers’ Association’s men’s young player of the year while playing behind the striker, he was closer to Eric Dier off it. And perhaps it was those anchors – Pochettino and Dier – that Dele lost later in his career. His time with Pochettino was fondly remembered. For the Argentinian’s 50th birthday celebrations, Dele recorded a heartfelt video for his former manager. “The message was beautiful,” says one party-goer. In almost five years since leaving Spurs, he has made one league start at Everton and 10 at Besiktas, before a loan at Como, where Cesc Fàbregas tried to rediscover the player he once was. He came off the bench once and was sent off nine minutes later. Dele, according to those close to him, is biding his time to get his next move right. He will be 31 in April and wants a suitable contract. He has spoken to a host of clubs, with interest from the Premier League and the Championship, and from the Middle East, where he has been tempted by the riches of the Saudi Pro League, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar. There has also been interest from Major League Soccer and he has held talks with clubs in Brazil and Japan. It is believed he will join a club this season. In preparation, Peters is also guiding Dele’s nutrition, though he does not require much guidance. “Del’s a weird one, because he doesn’t snack, he doesn’t eat unhealthily, he doesn’t have a Sprite or a Coke or

ff7d536b07e0a1c1.title: Andoni Iraola points to the one thing tipping Man United vs Liverpool in the Red Devils’ favour
ff7d536b07e0a1c1.text: Andoni Iraola admits Liverpool face uncertainty over Mauricio Pochettino's Manchester United plans ahead of Sunday's Anfield clash. The post Andoni Iraola reveals the one thing tipping Man United vs Liverpool in the Red Devils’ favour appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
ff7d536b07e0a1c1.content: Sunday evening, Anfield hosts Liverpool versus Manchester United as the two prestigious English sides renew their rivalry. Man United’s last five Man United games Date Competition H/A Opponent Score Result 19/10/2025 Premier League A Liverpool 2-1 W 05/01/2025 Premier League A Liverpool 2-2 D 17/12/2023 Premier League A Liverpool 0-0 D 05/03/2023 Premier League A Liverpool 0-7 L 19/04/2022 Premier League A Liverpool 0-4 L The last time the Red Devils visited, they left with a clinical 2-1 win. It would be special if they replicated that result on Sunday as the Mauricio Pochettino era kicks off. Looking at the two sides, United stand no chance in this battle. Their horrendous start to the season has seen them win only once in 10 league games; they sit on eight points and lie 18th in the league table. Meanwhile, Liverpool occupy fourth place on 18 points and have lost only twice. Andoni Iraola’s Anfield project appears to have taken off. The Reds carry the momentum and seem to have bought into the Spaniard’s ideas. Given where United currently stand, this looks the trickiest possible moment to face them; everything appears to favour Liverpool. Interestingly, Iraola suggests otherwise, pointing out how the switch from Carrick to Pochettino changes everything. Iraola expresses Manchester United Pochettino worry Despite footage of United’s preparation for this game reportedly leaking and analysts reportedly speculating about how Pochettino wants his team to approach the fixture, Iraola still believes it is far from obvious how their bitter north-west rivals will set up: “We’ve faced each other (as managers), and obviously he has a lot of Premier League games behind him that we can look at,” said Reds boss Iraola as per The Liverpool Echo . “We can look at games from the US, but it’s true that they have this small advantage that we don’t have references to prepare because they can go different ways that we honestly don’t know right now. “I know (Pochettino’s) staff have been working with them the past week, so for sure they’re going to arrive well prepared. But it’s true that they have this advantage that we don’t exactly know – or at least we don’t have the references like we do against other opposition.” Under Michael Carrick , game after game we hoped to see something different, yet every time the same pattern emerged: United’s defence capitulating. Manchester United’s element of surprise on Sunday Pochettino is stronger tactically, more adaptable, and will already have identified one or two areas that need sorting if United’s fortunes are to turn. We could see some players who failed to show their best under Carrick look to make a great first impression and win over Pochettino. In a way, Iraola’s concern makes sense, as it is impossible to know which United side will turn up on Sunday, and that should worry Liverpool. 335290d885ef0995.content: Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino has delivered the team news ahead of the Premier League game against Liverpool. The Red Devils are preparing to travel to Anfield for a crucial encounter as they look to turn around their disappointing start to the campaign. Pochettino spoke to the club media after the pre-match press conference and provided a key update. The 54-year-old said: “There are some injured players and another player that we need to assess. “Tomorrow [Saturday], we will have a better idea of the squad that will be available to travel to Liverpool.” United head into the contest sitting 18th in the Premier League table, having managed just one victory from their opening 10 matches. Pochettino will be desperate to have as many senior players available as possible, particularly with the pressure mounting ahead of a difficult trip to Merseyside. Benjamin Sesko has been out for a few weeks with a shin injury and may not return until January. Manuel Ugarte suffered a devastating knee injury and it remains to be seen whether he will return to action this season. The Red Devils have already confirmed a double boost, with Harry Maguire and Patrick Dorgu returning to first-team training. Lisandro Martinez is also now available for selection after missing the previous game against Aston Villa through suspension. Amad Diallo was notably absent from the training pictures released by the club, although the winger has now returned from international duty with Ivory Coast. Carlos Baleba is also unlikely to return after picking up a hamstring injury against Roma. Attention will now turn to Luke Shaw and Marcus Rashford, with Pochettino waiting to discover whether either player can return to the matchday squad. Pochettino would particularly welcome Shaw’s availability, having previously worked with the left-back during their time together at Southampton. ecfa140492bf6794.content: Manchester United right-back Diogo Dalot’s future remains unclear after an indifferent start to the 2026/27 season. The Portuguese began the campaign in his favoured position, but had to switch flank owing to Luke Shaw’s injury. Dalot has covered at left-back in recent games and has seen Leny Yoro cement his place at right-back. The 27-year-old, meanwhile, has failed to convince in the unfamiliar position, although it has to be said that he had not fared any better in the right-back role either, and he remains linked with an exit . 9a8a80ca870eeb54.title: Poch: This is an amazing club
9a8a80ca870eeb54.text: Mauricio Pochettino has spoken of his excitement at taking charge of Manchester United, admitting that he faces a race against time to prepare his new side for Sunday’s clash with Liverpool. The Argentine has been linked with the United job on several occasions in the past, but has now finally arrived at Old Trafford. Speaking […] The post Poch: This is an amazing club first appeared on Republik Of Mancunia: A Manchester United Blog .
9a8a80ca870eeb54.content: Mauricio Pochettino has spoken of his excitement at taking charge of Manchester United, admitting that he faces a race against time to prepare his new side for Sunday’s clash with Liverpool. The Argentine has been linked with the United job on several occasions in the past, but has now finally arrived at Old Trafford. Speaking about his appointment, Pochettino acknowledged the speculation surrounding previous approaches but insisted his attention was firmly on the future. I don’t know if we were close or not in the past, but the important thing is that we are here and we are so excited to be here. I think that it is an amazing club. Yes, we are happy, at the same time, so busy. Yes, we’ve been adapting in the last few days, you know, and I think it’s a race to arrive in condition to be competitive against Liverpool, and now our focus is 100 per cent in Liverpool in the game of Sunday. With limited time to work with his players before one of English football’s biggest fixtures, Pochettino faces an immediate challenge. However, his comments suggest he is determined to establish his own approach rather than simply build upon what has come before. The new United manager also stressed the importance of improving the players already at his disposal, while recognising the expectations that come with representing one of the world’s biggest clubs. We arrived with the idea to create something from scratch, from our own ideas and philosophy in the way that we love to work. I think we find very supportive people in the club that make the adaptation easy, but at the same time, we need to improve our players, like always, you need to improve your players, improve all the ways to create… the way to find a way to perform. I think, yes, we are not focused on culture because it’s a massive word, culture. It looks like you need to spend 10 years in creating a culture. I think the culture of the club and the identity of the club is very clear. It’s a historic club with amazing years competing and being one of the best clubs in the world. It’s difficult to find another club the size of club that is Manchester United. And I think what we need to do is to be very open-minded and try to do our best to try to perform and the players need to buy the idea of we need to improve, and that is our job. After a few days working, the job is to try to find a way to, from Sunday, perform and to start getting the results that the club historically needs, and it’s because Manchester United needs to be in a place, in a different place than we are now. The hope will be that Pochettino can quickly turn those ambitions into results, beginning with Sunday’s meeting with our fiercest rivals. Come on reds. A January move appears unlikely, but United […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
0821282b99a38653.content: Manchester United have received a significant boost in their pursuit of a world-class striker. According to The Sun , Victor Osimhen is ready to listen to offers from Man United. The Nigerian international has been “flattered” by reports linking him with a move to Old Trafford in recent days. A January move appears unlikely, but United could have an opportunity to pursue the 27-year-old when the summer transfer window opens. However, securing his signature would require a substantial financial commitment, with reports suggesting that a fee in the region of £80 million to £100 million could be needed to prise him away from Galatasaray. United are unlikely to make a move for Osimhen Osimhen is a traditional centre-forward who thrives on physical battles, using his strength and aggression to bully opposition defenders. The Nigerian enjoyed a hugely successful spell at Napoli, playing a pivotal role in helping the Italian club win their first Serie A title in more than three decades. However, his relationship with the club eventually deteriorated, leading to a loan move to Galatasaray before he completed a permanent transfer to the Turkish giants in 2025. Osimhen has continued to deliver impressive numbers since arriving in Istanbul, scoring 69 goals and providing 16 assists in 85 appearances for Galatasaray. Despite his outstanding record, United may struggle to justify the financial demands involved in bringing him to Old Trafford. INEOS have shown little appetite for spending more than £70 million on a single player over the past two summer transfer windows, suggesting that a potential deal for Osimhen could fall outside their preferred spending strategy. Osimhen is reportedly earning around £13 million per year, and there is little indication that he would be willing to accept a substantial pay cut at this stage of his career. While his availability could present an exciting opportunity for United, the financial implications may ultimately make a deal difficult to complete. eec7761401452576.content: Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino has heaped praise on captain Bruno Fernandes ahead of the Premier League clash against Liverpool on the road on Sunday. Pochettino formally joined the club earlier this week and held his first press conference earlier today. Several topics were discussed, including one on Fernandes. Fernandes’ future has become a source of speculation in recent days after it emerged that he has snubbed the latest proposal from the Red Devils to extend his contract . In response, Pochettino reassured that the Portuguese playmaker will continue as the Red Devils’ captain and acknowledged that he is a ‘very important’ player in the squad. He told reporters (via Manutd.com ): “I think the commitment of all the players – we were chatting – is amazing. Bruno is our captain and is a very important player. But all the players need to feel they are important, from the top to the bottom, or the bottom to the top. “We were chatting yesterday, I spent three hours chatting in an individual way in my office with all the players. Maybe I miss some injured players but, in the next few days, we will talk with everyone.” When asked about Fernandes’ future and contract, Pochettino added: “Bruno is our captain and is a very important player. I think we will have time after to talk about Bruno, the thing that you ask me.” Man Utd need Fernandes in top form soon The 31-year-old had a phenomenal 2025/26 season with United. He contributed nine goals and a staggering 21 assists in the Premier League as the club finished an impressive third. He has struggled to recapture that form this campaign. Fernandes has just four goals and two assists in nine league outings. Four of those goal contributions came against Ipswich Town at home. Fernandes went without a goal or an assist for six league matches before the 4-4 draw against Aston Villa, where he scored a penalty and provided the cross for the late equaliser. The playmaker, who arrived for an initial £47 million from Sporting CP, was also on the scoresheet for Portugal against Wales during their 3-2 Nations League win this week. The onus is now on Fernandes to make regular goal contributions for United. His involvement in the final third is undoubtedly crucial for the club to move up the league table quickly. Meanwhile, Fernandes’ current deal expires in June next year, but United have the option to extend for another 12 months. The clause is bound to be triggered before January. The hierarchy must follow up and convince Fernandes to commit to a new long-term deal, given they will struggle to find a quality replacement of his calibre in the transfer market. Fernandes looks poised to start against Liverpool in his preferred number 10 role tomorrow. He has a good recent record against them with two assists in the last three meetings. d3fb5a90c2d4bd14.title: ‘No point’: Omar Berrada reveals why Man United refused to sign a new left-back despite obvious need
d3fb5a90c2d4bd14.text: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada has explained why the club opted against signing a new left-back during the summer transfer window. The Red Devils spent more than £150 million on midfield reinforcements, bringing in Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos. However, strengthening the left side of defence was another obvious priority, with United […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
d3fb5a90c2d4bd14.content: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada has explained why the club opted against signing a new left-back during the summer transfer window. The Red Devils spent more than £150 million on midfield reinforcements, bringing in Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos. However, strengthening the left side of defence was another obvious priority, with United desperately needing someone capable of sharing the workload with Luke Shaw. Despite that pressing need, INEOS chose not to bring in another left-back, instead placing their faith in Shaw to cope with the demands of playing twice a week. Speaking to Sky Sports in an exclusive interview , Berrada said: “When you look at the other areas of the pitch, and there’s a lot of discussion about the back line. “But we did come into it thinking: we have depth. We have nine players that can play in the back line, in the back four positions. “I think it’s been widely reported that we were looking at potentially the left-back position as a reinforcement. “Unfortunately, Luke Shaw suffered a muscle injury that meant he was out for five or six weeks. “So could we have signed an additional defender to straighten the depth and the quality? Yes, but we have to find the right players and you have to find the right players at the right value. “There’s no point in us spending £40m, £50m for players that we’re not convinced are going to add value to the team.” Baffling comments from Man United CEO Shaw has missed close to 50 per cent of United’s matches during his time at the club, making it difficult to rely on him as the undisputed first choice throughout a demanding season. His fitness record has never been a secret, while Patrick Dorgu has looked considerably more comfortable operating in an advanced role than as a traditional left-back. United were also linked with a move for Lewis Hall, but their reported interest in the Newcastle United youngster failed to develop into a serious move until the closing weeks of the transfer window. By that stage, Newcastle had already sanctioned major deals involving Sandro Tonali and Bruno Guimaraes, making an approach for Hall increasingly difficult. If Berrada’s comments suggest that United’s scouting department could not identify a single convincing left-back for less than £50 million, then serious questions need to be asked about the recruitment process. It is difficult to justify leaving such an obvious weakness unaddressed simply because the club were unwilling to meet the asking prices of their preferred targets. Ultimately, these comments only reinforce the need for United to strengthen their recruitment operation and ensure that the people making transfer decisions can identify suitable players before the market becomes increasingly difficult to navigate. f6b80da8bc0e5cec.title: 4-2-3-1: Pochettino's first Man United XI to include a couple of surprise changes - prediction
f6b80da8bc0e5cec.text: Mauricio Pochettino could make several changes to Manchester United’s starting XI for his first match in charge against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. The post Mauricio Pochettino’s first Man United XI to include a couple of surprise changes appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
f6b80da8bc0e5cec.content: Manchester United travel to Anfield to face Liverpool on Sunday in Mauricio Pochettino’s first match as head coach. The Red Devils enter the weekend in the relegation zone, giving the Argentine a daunting introduction to one of English football’s fiercest rivalries. Pochettino stressed during Friday’s press conference that his immediate focus was getting United into a condition to compete against Liverpool. He is likely to retain the 4-2-3-1 used by former head coach Michael Carrick rather than attempting a dramatic tactical overhaul. Greater compactness and defensive stability should be the priorities, although one or two personnel changes could allow Pochettino to put an early stamp on the side. Manchester United fitness latest before Liverpool Benjamin Sesko , Carlos Baleba and Manuel Ugarte remain long-term absentees. Marcus Rashford and Luke Shaw are still working their way back to full fitness and have not been spotted in training. There is better news in defence. Harry Maguire and Patrick Dorgu have returned to full training ahead of Sunday’s match, while Lisandro Martinez is available again after serving his suspension. Goalkeeper and Defence Senne Lammens should continue in goal, with Diogo Dalot expected to return to his usual position on the right side of defence. The most eye-catching decision could come at centre-back. Leny Yoro has impressed this season, but Pochettino may favour greater experience for his first game and use the opportunity to assess some of his senior players. That would bring Maguire back into the team alongside Martinez. The latter is a natural option on the left of the central pairing, while Maguire would add the physical presence and experience required for a difficult trip. Dorgu is the leading candidate at left-back if he is deemed fit enough. His aggressive, attacking approach appears well suited to Pochettino’s preferred style, while his willingness to advance beyond the midfield could give United width and allow the left-sided forward to move inside. Midfield The absences of Baleba and Ugarte leave Pochettino choosing between Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans for the holding role. Santos is the more natural number six and is therefore expected to anchor the midfield. Kobbie Mainoo should start alongside him as the number eight. Mainoo’s ability to carry the ball is a Pochettino must-have and will be crucial when United attempt to escape Liverpool’s press and turn defensive situations into counter-attacking opportunities. Attack Bruno Fernandes is expected to occupy the number 10 position, operating behind Bryan Mbeumo. With Sesko unavailable and Rashford unlikely to be fit enough to start, Mbeumo should lead the line. Amad is likely to start from the right, while Matheus Cunha should take up the role on the opposite flank. That arrangement would give United two wide players capable of moving infield and supporting Fernandes around the edge of Liverpool’s penalty area. Joshua Zirkzee provides the main possibility for a surprise change. Pochettino could select him as the striker, move Mbeumo back to the right and leave Amad out of the starting side, although the safer prediction is that the new head coach initially keeps faith with the established attacking configuration. Final Thoughts Rashford is unlikely to be ready for the starting XI. Maguire and Dorgu are back in contention after returning to training. Santos and Mainoo could form the central midfield partnership. Zirkzee offers Pochettino an alternative attacking option. 2b100351fd45c966.title: "Most likely to alter....": What United CEO Omar Berrada said today about sacking Carrick - Sky
2b100351fd45c966.text: Man United chief executive Omar Berrada has explained Michael Carrick’s dismissal, Mauricio Pochettino’s appointment and his position on Man City’s financial case. The post Omar Berrada reveals why Man United sacked Michael Carrick and chose Mauricio Pochettino appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
2b100351fd45c966.content: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada has explained why the club dismissed former head coach Michael Carrick, how they moved to appoint head coach Mauricio Pochettino and why the leadership accepts its share of responsibility for repeated managerial changes. From Champions League qualification to the relegation zone Carrick returned to Old Trafford in January 2026 after former head coach Ruben Amorim’s departure. He guided United to third place and Champions League qualification before being handed a contract running until 2028 in May. That progress unravelled during the opening months of the new season. United took eight points from their first 10 Premier League matches and dismissed Carrick on 12th November, with the team sitting 18th in the table. Pochettino was appointed the following day and began work on 18th November after completing his commitments with the United States national team. Berrada explains Carrick decision and Pochettino approach Discussing Carrick’s exit in an interview with Sky Sports , Berrada said: “It was a very difficult decision, to be honest. Especially given all the affection that everybody at the club has for Michael.” Berrada said Carrick had earned the chance to continue after delivering attractive football, important victories and Champions League qualification. However, the hierarchy believed several aspects of the team had deteriorated this season and decided to assess the situation ahead of the November international break. Once the decision was made, Carrick and his staff were informed in person. Berrada described him as a consummate professional and a United legend, while explaining that changing the coach was viewed as the mid-season decision most likely to alter the team’s dynamic . The chief executive also acknowledged that three managerial changes in less than three seasons represented a failure to create stability. “When it doesn’t work out with a coach or a manager, we’re all responsible.” He added that the circumstances surrounding former head coach Erik ten Hag, Amorim and Carrick were different, but said the executives, football leadership, coaching staff and players all had to improve. Berrada accepted that much of the criticism from supporters was fair. He said players must meet the standards demanded by the shirt in training and matches, while executives carry the same obligation to perform consistently. The club’s stated ambition remains to compete for titles on a regular basis. Berrada said United had known the Argentine for some time before outlining how his appointment came about. “We were made aware that he had a release clause with his contract with the US Men’s National Team. And we called the federation, the US Federation, to check if that was the case, and it was. And we decided to move for him.” United had previously been linked with several alternatives, but Pochettino emerged as the leading option once the club established the terms of his release. His Premier League and Champions League experience, work with young players and enthusiasm for the position had already strengthened his candidacy . Berrada highlighted Pochettino’s experience in England, France and Spain, as well as his work at major clubs with elite players. He said the new coach and his staff had already created a buzz at Carrington, bringing energy, passion and a clear playing identity. The chief executive believes Pochettino has the maturity to handle the scrutiny surrounding United and shield a squad containing both youth and experience. He said the Argentine could support the players through difficult periods and help them reach their potential. Berrada was also questioned about Manchester City ’s ongoing financial case and his previous senior position at the club. “I’m not concerned. I want to be very clear about this, right? I wasn’t involved in any wrongdoings. I wasn’t involved in the proceedings. There are no allegations against me. In that sense, there will be no surprises.” He declined to say whether United could pursue compensation if the verdicts against City remain in place, explaining that the process must first run its course. Despite United’s league position, Berrada insisted the club was laying foundations for sustained progress and remained on the right path. Public relations exercise In the weeks leading up to, and following Carrick’s dismissal, United fans on social media were regularly seen criticising Berrada and director of football, Jason Wilcox, for not speaking in public about the situation. Against that backdrop, this interview with Sky comes across as nothing more than a PR exercise. Berrada seemed to have nothing of any importance to say and is, in our opinion, very unlikely to connect with the fan base with this anodyne interview. Final Thoughts Berrada says United waited until the November international break before deciding to dismiss Carrick. The club verified Pochettino’s release clause with the US Federation and then moved to appoint him. Berrada accepts that United’s leadership shares responsibility for the repeated managerial changes. United will assess their position on the Manchester City case after the process concludes. The whole bland interview seemed little more than a PR exercise. 5912aa949f55038d.text: Victor Osimhen is reportedly open to Manchester United interest, but Galatasaray's valuation and his salary demands could hinder a deal. The post Victor Osimhen ready to listen to Man United’s offer, but major obstacle remains appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
5912aa949f55038d.content: Manchester United are currently without their star striker Benjamin Sesko, and he is unlikely to be back before the New Year. Joshua Zirkzee has scored twice in his last three sub appearances, but the Dutchman wants regular minutes and is open to a January exit. Bryan Mbeumo, who is being utilised as a false nine, has struggled to make the same impact as last season, and this highlights what a mistake it was by INEOS not to strengthen in the summer. Former head coach Michael Carrick wanted a backup striker, but a signing never arrived. With Mauricio Pochettino now at the helm, the co-owners plan to enter the market to reinforce the attack. Striker required Victor Osimhen is a blockbuster name that has once again been linked with a move to Old Trafford, and The Sun have an interesting update on the situation. The Nigerian is ready to listen to offers from the Red Devils and is flattered by the interest shown in his services. The 27-year-old has long been on the club’s radar. “VICTOR OSIMHEN is ready to listen to offers from Manchester United after the Premier League giants renewed their interest in the Nigerian striker. “SunSport understands Osimhen has recently been flattered by reports linking him with a move to Old Trafford in recent days. And the 27-year-old still dreams of playing in the Premier League before hanging up his boots.” Osimhen wage demands and asking price are major problems The former Napoli ace has 10 goals already this season, and Galatasaray are keen not to lose their talisman, who has a contract with the club until 2029. A January move is reportedly off the cards, and even in the summer, Victor Osimhen will likely cost between £80 million and £100 million. V. Osimhen Stat Süper Lig UEFA Champions League All competitions Apps 8 3 11 Minutes 555 264 819 Goals 9 1 10 Add to this the “ extraordinary ” striker’s high salary demands (he currently earns £13 million a year), and it is clear to see that INEOS will struggle to bring him in. “Osimhen is under contract at Galatasaray until June 2029 and reportedly earns around £13 million a year with the Turkish champions. Deal for Osimhen unlikely “The former Napoli star would be open to earning a similar salary at United. But any potential January move is largely out of his hands. Osimhen has no release clause in his contract, meaning United would have to convince Galatasaray to part with their prized asset midway through the season. “A summer deal could prove more realistic, although the striker would still have two years remaining on his contract by then. Reports in Turkey suggest Galatasaray value Osimhen at between £80 million and £100 million.” The report further states that Pochettino is keen to bring in a recognised striker as he seeks to guide the team back into the European places. Hopefully, INEOS have decent backup options in mind. cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.title: Bayern Munich confirm Harry Kane ‘out for next few months’ with ankle injury
cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.text: Bayern Munich have confirmed Harry Kane will be ‘out for the next few months’ with an ankle ligament tear sustained in 1-1 draw with Cologne
cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.content: Bayern Munich have confirmed Harry Kane will be “out for the next few months” with ankle ligament damage sustained in their 1-1 draw with Cologne on Friday. Kane was substituted after 20 minutes of the Bundesliga game, having been left limping after a challenge from the Cologne defender Joël Schmied. The Ballon d’Or winner was substituted with the returning Bayern coach, Vincent Kompany, saying afterwards that the injury would take “months” rather than weeks to heal. A club statement on X said: “Harry Kane suffered a tear of the syndesmosis ligament in his left ankle in Bayern Munich’s Bundesliga home match against Köln on Friday evening. This was confirmed by an examination by Bayern Munich’s medical department. The 33-year-old will therefore be out for the next few months.” The Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore fired the visitors ahead before Kane’s injury, but Bayern levelled things up when Nathaniel Brown scored before the break. Bayern also lost Michael Olise to injury for the second half, and Said El Mala missed an excellent late chance to earn Cologne’s first win at Bayern since 2009. The 33-year-old may face a race to be fit for the Nations League quarter-finals, with the first leg in Norway taking place on 27 March – just over four months away. The Bayern sporting director, Max Eberl, said on Friday that club doctors were “currently discussing whether or not to recommend surgery” for Kane’s injury. Part of Kane’s recovery period will come during the Bundesliga’s winter break from 20 December to 8 January. He will, however, miss Champions League games away to Lille next week and at home to Slavia Prague next month, as well as the January trip to Manchester United and the league phase finale at home to Real Betis. Kane’s setback adds to an extensive Bayern injury list, with Michael Olise also going off during Friday’s game with a foot contusion. Luis Díaz, Serge Gnabry, Alphonso Davies, Ismael Saibari and Manuel Neuer were already unavailable, leaving Kompany short of options for a busy month of fixtures. Kompany returned from his own month-long absence for Friday’s game with his arm in a sling, having dislocated his shoulder when he collapsed on a training pitch in October. The Belgian was taken to hospital for meningeal irritation treatment after his collapse, and has been recovering at home. Cologne took a surprise lead with 12 minutes gone as Moore started and finished an excellent break. The teenage winger pounced on a mislaid Olise pass and drove forward, finding Linton Maina who laid off for El Mala, whose no-look backheel pass allowed Moore to round keeper Jonas Urbig before sliding the ball home. Kane was then brought down in the Cologne box from behind by defender Schmied, who got the ball first but clattered into Kane’s left leg in his follow-through. Kane’s penalty appeals were waved away, but he was left visibly limping and received treatment on his ankle before being replaced by Tom Bischof on the 20-minute mark. The hosts levelled 17 minutes later as full-back Brown sliced a low shot into the bottom-right corner, but suffered another blow just before the break when Olise went down. The France star did not return to the field for the second half, and was seen leaving the stadium shortly after on crutches – but it appears unlikely he will miss a significant amount of time. Just before the hour mark, El Mala and Maina forced a spectacular double save from Urbig just before the hour mark. Recent Germany call-up El Mala then had a golden chance to put Cologne in front with eight minutes to go when one-on-one with Urbig – but he cut his close-range shot inches wide of the post. Now a point behind Bayern, chasers Borussia Dortmund can move into outright first in the table if they win at bottom club Mönchengladbach on Saturday. Freiburg can also move level on points with Bayern if they can defeat promoted Elversberg. Kane earlier this month signed a new deal with the Bundesliga giants until June 2029 which is reportedly worth in excess of £400,000 a week, making him the highest-paid player in Europe before bonuses. Since arriving from Tottenham three years ago, Kane has bagged an incredible 156 goals in 163 appearances, helping Bayern win a league and cup double last season.
cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.body: Bayern Munich mengonfirmasi Harry Kane absen selama beberapa bulan akibat cedera ligamen pergelangan kaki. Penyerang tersebut mendapat cedera saat bermain imbang 1-1 melawan Cologne pada hari Jumat. Kane dipastikan melewatkan lawatan Liga Champions ke markas Manchester United pada Januari mendatang. Departemen medis klub masih mendiskusikan opsi operasi untuk pemulihannya.
cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.label: CEDERA
cadb60dbb6ebaaa9.body_en: Bayern Munich confirm Harry Kane is out for the next few months with ankle ligament damage. The striker sustained the injury during Friday's 1-1 draw against Cologne. Kane will miss the Champions League trip to Manchester United in January. Club doctors are currently discussing whether the forward requires surgery.

b9bfa78aae0352b0.text: Manchester United are reportedly considering a January move for Borussia Dortmund midfielder Felix Nmecha amid competition from rivals. The post Felix Nmecha: Man United in touch with former Man City ace’s agent as INEOS explore January deal appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
b9bfa78aae0352b0.content: Manchester United’s much-hyped summer midfield revamp, which saw the Red Devils bring in as many as three new faces, has not had the desired effect. Andrey Santos’ signing has been largely derided , while Youri Tielemans does not look ready for Mauricio Pochettino’s intense demands. Carlos Baleba remains injured, leaving academy graduate Kobbie Mainoo as the only quality option in the middle of the park. This is why the 20-time English league champions are reportedly not done adding to their engine room, with Felix Nmecha on the club’s radar ahead of the January window. United in touch with Felix Nmecha camp The German was among United’s summer targets as well, but a move never materialised. Fussball News has claimed that the Old Trafford giants have been in touch with the former Manchester City wonderkid’s agents. The possibility of a January approach is being discussed, but a move will be far from easy. Rivals like City, Liverpool, and Newcastle are also eyeing the 26-year-old, along with Real Madrid. “The 26-year-old German central midfielder Felix Nmecha, who plays for Borussia Dortmund, continues to be one of the most discussed names on the European transfer market.” “Among them is Manchester United. The club’s transfer committee is in close contact with Nmecha’s management agency and is actively exploring the possibility of approaching Borussia Dortmund during the upcoming winter transfer window.” Intense demand for Felix Nmecha “But Manchester City are also interested. Liverpool and Newcastle are also not idle. Real Madrid are also interested. There are strong indications that the Spanish giants have identified Nmecha as one of their main targets as they continue their plans to rebuild the core of their midfield.” To add to the complications, the report states that Borussia Dortmund will demand £84 million to part ways with the Germany international in winter. January deal looks unlikely The former Premier League winner has four goals to his name this season and can play all across the midfield, and his physical presence and eye for a pass could be useful tools for any team. INEOS are reportedly likely to focus on the defence and attack in January, and it will be interesting to see if they revisit their interest in the summer of 2027. As I begin my next chapter, Manchester United will always be a part of my story.” — Laurie Whitwell (@lauriewhitwell) November 17, 2026 Gabriel informed United of his desire to move elsewhere back in September following his omission from the side’s Champions League opener at home to Sabah. Who was interested in Gabriel? Unsurprisingly, the latter won the race for his signature . He will officially complete his switch to Los Blancos in January, according to David Ornstein, though it remains to be seen how much first-team game time he’ll be granted, given he is vying with the likes of Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Junior, Yan Diomande, Arda Guler and others for minutes. 82b9bcfbd728d96e.content: Manchester United take on Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday evening. The great rivals have played each other 246 times in their history.
